name: Purify Air
description: Removes all impurities, smoke, toxic gas, poisons, and stale odor from air in area of effect, turning it into fresh, breathable air instantly. Does not create air where there is a vacuum.

name: Create Air
description: Creates breathable air in a vacuum, underwater (as bubbles), or in open air (creating a breeze). Fills empty spaces in stone or earth. The created air remains permanently after the 5-second spell duration.

name: No-Smell
description: Removes all body odors and scents from the subject and carried gear, making the subject completely undetectable by smell, scent tracking, or bloodhounds.

name: Odor
description: Creates any odor desired by the caster at a specific location or around a subject. Can mimic familiar scents, flowers, decay, or distinctive markers. Gives +2 to tracking rolls if used to scent a trail.

name: Predict Weather
description: Accurately forecasts natural weather conditions for a specified location over a given number of days. Reveals wind, temperature, rain, storms, and natural atmospheric phenomena.

name: Shape Air
description: Creates a stream of wind 1 yard wide. 1 energy = gentle breeze, 4 = wind, 6 = heavy wind, 8+ = violent blast doing knockback (1d knockback per 2 energy). Can deflect ranged missiles or push objects.

name: Stench
description: Produces a cloud of foul yellowish brimstone gas. Those breathing it must roll HT every minute or take 1d damage and begin suffocating. Retains potency for 5 minutes unless cleared by Purify Air.

name: Air Vision
description: Allows the subject to see clearly through fog, smoke, dust storms, gas clouds, and murky air as if it were completely clear daylight air. Ignores vision penalties from atmospheric obscurity.

name: Body of Air
description: Transforms the subject and carried gear into gaseous air. Subject becomes immune to physical weapons (except magic/energy), can slip through keyholes and cracks, and moves at Flight Move equal to Basic Speed.

name: Breathe Air
description: Allows a water-breathing creature or creature in a vacuum/toxic atmosphere to breathe air normally without harm.

name: Concussion
description: Hurls a compressed ball of air dealing 1d crushing damage per energy spent (max 3d). Targets struck must roll ST or be knocked down. Range 1/2D 10, Max 20, Acc 1.

name: Devitalize Air
description: Removes oxygen from the air in the area of effect. Creatures in the area must hold their breath or begin suffocating immediately. Extinguishes ordinary fires instantly.

name: Earth to Air
description: Transforms earth, sand, or stone into fresh, breathable air permanently. Essential for freeing trapped miners or excavating tunnels.

name: Walk on Air
description: Allows subject to walk on air as if it were solid ground (up to a 45° incline). Moving upward counts as climbing. Taking damage or falling breaks spell concentration.

name: Windstorm
description: Creates a swirling gale in the area. Imposes -2 to missile attacks per energy level, halves Move inside, and forces DX rolls to remain standing for lightweight creatures.

name: Air Jet
description: Shoots a high-pressure jet of air from the caster's hand. Deals 1d knockback damage per energy point up to 5 yards range. Does no lethal damage but can knock foes down or off cliffs.

name: Lightning
description: Shoots a bolt of electrical lightning dealing 1d-1 electrical damage per energy spent. Metallic armor counts as DR 1 against lightning! Target struck must roll HT-1 per 2 HP damage taken or be stunned.

name: Explosive Lightning
description: Hurls a bolt of lightning that explodes on impact, dealing 1d-1 electrical damage per 2 energy to target and nearby foes (divided by 3x distance in yards for blast area). Metal armor counts as DR 1.

name: Spark Cloud
description: Fills area with crackling electrical sparks. Anyone inside takes 1d-3 electrical damage per second. Metal armor offers no DR against spark cloud damage.

name: Wall of Wind
description: Creates a vertical wall of gale-force wind. Completely stops arrows, bolts, and light thrown weapons. Physical creatures passing through must roll ST-3 or be knocked back.

name: Whirlwind
description: Creates a violent tornado-like vortex. Lifts loose debris, blinds creatures inside, deals 1d crushing damage per turn, and forces ST rolls to avoid being swept into the air.

name: Essential Air
description: Creates magical air that is three times as dense in oxygen and pure life force. A single lungful sustains breath for 3 times longer. Essential Air cannot be contaminated or turned into toxic gas.

name: Air Golem
description: Animates a body of air into an invisible, loyal golem servant that can perform tasks, guard locations, or strike enemies with winds.

name: Summon Air Elemental
description: Conjures a living Air Elemental spirit from the elemental plane. Caster must command it or win a Contest of Will to enforce obedience.

name: Control Air Elemental
description: Binds and controls a summoned or wild Air Elemental upon winning a Quick Contest of Skill vs Elemental's Will.

name: Create Air Elemental
description: Creates a permanent Air Elemental servant bound to the caster or a specific location.

name: Ball Lightning
description: Creates a floating globe of electrical energy that moves towards targets at Move 5 and explodes on touch dealing 1d-1 electrical damage per energy. Metal armor counts as DR 1.

name: Lightning Whip
description: Conjures a crackling whip of electricity (Reach 1-4). Deals 2d electrical damage on hit, ignores metal armor (DR 1 against lightning), and forces HT-2 stun rolls.

name: Lightning Wall
description: Creates a curtain of electrical lightning. Anyone passing through takes 2d electrical damage (metal armor offers DR 1) and must roll HT-2 to avoid being stunned.

name: Lightning Armor
description: Envelops the subject in crackling electrical aura. Anyone striking subject in melee takes 1d electrical damage immediately.

name: Shocking Touch
description: Inflicts 1d electrical damage per energy spent on a successful bare touch attack in melee. Ignores metal armor (metal DR counts as 1). Stuns target on failed HT roll.

name: Spark Storm
description: Creates an intensified electrical storm dealing 1d-1 electrical damage per second to all within area. Blinds creatures inside on failed HT roll.

name: Steal Air
description: Sucks the air directly out of the target's lungs upon failing HT resistance roll. Target takes 1d fatigue damage and is stunned for 1 turn coughing and gasping.

name: Sandstorm
description: Creates a blinding desert sandstorm. Deals 1d-2 abrasive damage per turn to all creatures inside, blinds vision completely, and imposes -4 to all physical skill rolls.

name: Beast-Soother
duration: Permanent, until something disturbs the animal.
prerequisites: Persuasion or the Animal Empathy advantage.
description: Calms a single animal. The beast's reaction roll to the caster is improved by twice the energy put into the spell.

name: Beast-Rouser
duration: Until a reaction roll is called for or an hour passes.
prerequisites: Vexation or the Animal Empathy advantage.
description: Excites a single animal. The beast's reaction roll (to anyone) is worsened by twice the energy put into the spell.

name: (Animal) Control
initialCost: Variable (Equal to racial IQ of most intelligent species in category: Vermin 1, Fish 2, Reptile 2, Bird 3, Mammal 5).
maintenanceCost: Half initial cost (Vermin 1, Fish 1, Reptile 1, Bird 2, Mammal 3).
description: Controls the actions of one large animal (any size) or a single swarm (see Swarm Attacks, p. B461). Remember, however, that subjects larger than SM 0 increase the casting cost. Concentration is required. This spell will not work on a sapient being (racial IQ 6 or higher). There is a separate Control spell for each category of animal (Vermin, Fish, Reptiles, Birds, Mammals).

name: Hybrid Control
description: Controls the actions of one large hybrid creature (any size) or a single swarm (see Swarm Attacks, p. B461). Remember, however, that subjects larger than SM 0 increase the casting cost. Concentration is required. The caster must know all the Control spells relevant to the hybrid (controlling a gryphon would require knowledge of both Mammal and Bird Control, for example); his effective skill with this spell is the lowest of the various spells involved, including Hybrid Control. This spell does not work on a sapient being (racial IQ 6 or higher).

name: Beast Summoning
initialCost: 3 (Double cost to call all creatures in a 10-mile area)
description: Calls one creature of a named type (anything under IQ 6). Range does not matter for this spell. If the spell is cast successfully, the caster knows the location of the closest creature of the type, and how long it will take for that creature to come to him. It moves toward the caster as fast as it can, until the spell ends or the animal can see the caster. It stays nearby, without attacking, until the spell ends. The summoned animal then has a +1 on its reaction to the caster (only). If the caster or someone near the caster attacks the creature, the spell is broken. To call many animals, double the cost of the spell. All creatures within a certain area (usually about a 10-mile radius; more for a very successful casting) are summoned.

name: Master
description: Holds any beast motionless and quiet as long as the caster maintains eye contact and concentration. Note that darkness breaks eye contact! May be cast as a Blocking spell if the animal is entering Close Combat range with the caster – e.g., to attack.

name: Beast Link
duration: Until the beast is next called. Counts as a spell 'on.'
description: Establishes a mental link with an animal. The animal will not stray far from the caster after that (generally not more than a half-hour's travel). It will then come, once, whenever the caster wishes, at a fast but not killing pace. If it is a wild beast, any reactions must be re-determined when the creature arrives; previous good reactions from Beast-Soother, for instance, no longer hold! This spell is similar to Beast-Summoning, but is cast in advance and on a specific creature.

name: Beast Speech
description: Communicate with any animal in the creature's own 'language.' The amount of information exchanged depends on the animal's intelligence; no creature below the level of a bird is likely to know much of interest. An ant may crawl over gold, but it knows only that the material is hard and inedible. Each minute of the spell allows one question and answer.

name: Repel (Animal)
initialCost: Base cost equal to cost to cast (Animal) Control for affected type (Vermin 1, Fish 2, Reptile 2, Bird 3, Mammal 5).
prerequisites: The (Animal) Control spell appropriate to the type of animal to be repelled.
description: Repels animals from an area. The spell resists attempts by animals to enter it (or stay in it) every second; roll a Quick Contest between the caster's effective skill and the Animal's ST. Like (Animal) Control, this is actually several different spells for each category of animal. Affected area extends 4 yards upward (double base cost for 8 yards high, etc.). Beings with Animal Empathy may feel uneasy and irritable in the area. Caster may exclude specific animals at casting time.

name: Repel Hybrids
description: Repels hybrids from an area. The spell resists attempts by hybrids to enter it (or stay in it); every second, roll a Quick Contest between the caster's effective skill and the beast's ST. The caster must know all the Repel (Animal) spells relevant to the hybrid; his effective skill with this spell is the lowest of the various spells involved, including Repel Hybrids. Beings with Animal Empathy may feel uneasy and irritable while in the area. Caster may exclude specific animals at casting time.

name: Rider
prerequisites: At least one (Animal) Control spell. You cannot use the Rider spell on a beast unless you know the appropriate Control spell and cast it first.
description: Mount and ride a subject creature as though it were a trained, loyal riding animal. The creature must be capable of carrying the caster, and the caster must still make a Riding roll whenever it would normally be required. No concentration is required on the caster's part.

name: Rider Within
prerequisites: At least two different (Animal) Control spells. The caster must also know the (Animal) Control spell for the type of animal being 'ridden' before he can use this spell on that type of animal.
description: Works on any type of animal (but not sapient beings). This is the animal version of the Soul Rider spell. The caster becomes able to see through the subject's eyes, hear through its ears, etc, as long as he concentrates. (He also remains aware of his own body and may act normally.) The caster exerts no control whatsoever over the subject, and the subject is unaware the caster is 'watching.'

name: Spider Silk
initialCost: 1 per 5 yards of strand length (max 100 yards).
description: Shoot a strand of sticky spider silk from your fingertip at a target. The strand has ST 15 for entangling or pulling objects/foes. Requires Innate Attack or Throwing roll to hit.

name: Beast Seeker
prerequisites: Either Beast Summoning and at least two other Seek spells, or Seeker.
description: This spell is similar to Seeker (p. 105), but it works only on animals. It may be cast for any species of animal, an individual, or simply any animal.

name: Beast Possession
description: Like Rider Within – except caster is in full control of the subject, 'from the inside,' and has full access to the beast's memories and abilities. While in the subject's body, the caster may use all its skills and abilities as though they were his own. He may use his own mental abilities, but not his physical ones (so he cannot cast spells unless he knows them so well that they require no speech or gesture). The caster's own body lies unconscious during the spell, and must be safeguarded.

name: Permanent Beast Possession
description: Like Beast Possession, but the caster's consciousness remains in the body of the subject until he chooses to leave or is 'exorcised' by a Dispel Possession, Counterspell, Remove Curse, or similar spell. Remember that the caster must know the appropriate (Animal) Control spell for the spell to work on the chosen subject. The caster's body is in Suspended Animation (p. 94) while the spell continues. If the caster's body dies, the spell is broken. Whenever the subject body takes damage, the caster must roll against his own body's HT or take the same damage. If the subject animal dies, the caster must roll vs. HT or die himself! In addition, the caster must roll against his IQ every day; a failed roll means that he loses one point of IQ. The caster does not need to roll once he reaches the beast's normal IQ range. The lost IQ is regained when the spell is ended. Should IQ drop to 5, only Remove Curse or Dispel Possession will end the spell.

name: Protect Animal
prerequisites: Armor, Watchdog, and any three Animal spells.
description: Cast on an area, this spell protects all animals of a certain kind within its borders. Attempts to harm them are warded off as if by invisible defenders; protected animals gain DB +3 and DR 5. This is also a Protection and Warning spell.

name: Shapeshifting
initialCost: 6 for typical natural beast forms (or 1/20 of physical point cost for custom forms, min 3).
maintenanceCost: 2 for typical natural beast forms (or 1/60 of physical point cost, min 1).
description: Change to the form of an animal. Each animal form is a different spell, to be learned separately. The caster may only learn the form of an animal with which he is familiar. Clothing, jewelry, and armor vanish when the beastform is taken and reappear when the human form is resumed. Backpacks and carried items fall to the ground. Caster retains intelligence, but gains all physical attributes of the new form. Cannot cast spells unless known well enough to perform without gestures/speech. Each hour, caster rolls vs IQ; failure reduces IQ by 1 until normal beast IQ is reached. If IQ drops to 5, trapped in beast form until Remove Curse is cast.

name: Shapeshift Others
prerequisites: Magery 2 and Shapeshifting for that form.
description: As Shapeshifting, but usable on others. The subject cannot end the spell; only the caster, or a Remove Curse spell, can do that. If the spell continues until the subject's IQ drops to 5, he is trapped in the beast form!

name: Permanent Shapeshifting
initialCost: 5 times the cost of the corresponding Shapeshifting spell.
prerequisites: Magery 3 and Shapeshifting for that form.
description: Like Shapeshifting, but the subject remains in animal form until he chooses to resume his normal form. He must roll for IQ loss daily rather than hourly.

name: Partial Shapeshifting
initialCost: Varies by body part (e.g., Feathered Arms 3, Fish Tail 3, Mountain Goat Hooves 4, Saber Teeth 5, Scorpion Tail 7, Serpent's Fangs 3, Skunk Tail 3, Spider Arms 7, Tiger Paws 4, Toad Tongue 3, Turtle Shell 10; never less than 3).
prerequisites: Magery 3, Shapeshift Others for the appropriate animal, and Alter Body.
description: Transforms a single part of the subject's body into an animal counterpart, granting specific advantages and attacks (e.g. Feathered Arms grants Winged Flight, Serpent's Fangs grants venomous bite, Turtle Shell grants DR 5, etc.).

name: Great Shapeshift
initialCost: 20 (plus 1 per additional 5 character points of template limit).
prerequisites: Magery 3, Great Shapeshift for that form or 4 Shapeshifting spells.
description: Allows instant, fluid shapeshifting into animal form in combat. The caster remains subject to Magic Rituals requirements while shapeshifted; if he changes into a form that cannot gesture or speak, he cannot use any spell known at skill less than 20. Opposing mages can use Counterspell to hold a Great Shapeshifted caster in their current form.

name: Itch
description: Causes a fierce itch on one spot of the subject's body. The subject is at -2 to DX and all DX-based skills until he spends one full turn scratching the itch. No armor protects against this spell.

name: Spasm
description: Causes an involuntary muscle contraction in the subject. If cast on a hand, the subject drops whatever he is holding. If cast on a leg, he stumbles for -1 to DX on his next turn. If cast on an arm while attacking or casting a spell, the action fails.

name: Clumsiness
description: Reduces the subject's DX, and all DX-based skills, by 1 point per energy spent (maximum 5 points). DX cannot be reduced below 0.

name: Pain
description: Inflicts a sudden, agonizing stab of pain on the subject. The subject must make a Will roll to avoid crying out in pain, a DX roll to avoid dropping items or falling if climbing, and suffers a -3 penalty to DX and IQ on his next turn.

name: Stun
description: Mentally stuns the subject. The subject may roll against HT at the end of each turn to recover. Until he recovers, he can take no action except active defenses at -2.

name: Paralyze Limb
prerequisites: Magery 1, Pain, and 4 other Body Control spells
description: Caster must touch a limb (arm or leg) of the subject. On a hit and failed HT roll, the struck limb becomes limp and completely paralyzed for the duration, rendering it unusable. A paralyzed leg causes the subject to fall.

name: Total Paralysis
description: Completely paralyzes the subject's entire body except for involuntary functions (breathing, heartbeat). The subject cannot move, speak, or cast spells requiring gestures or speech. Mental spells remain possible.

name: Deathtouch
description: Caster touches the subject. The touch deals 1d crushing damage per energy spent (maximum 3d) directly to the subject's internal organs. This damage ignores all worn armor and natural DR.

name: Wither Limb
description: Caster touches a limb of the subject. If the subject fails a HT roll, the struck limb instantly withers and shrinks, suffering maximum crippling damage. The limb is permanently crippled until cured by Restoration or magical healing.

name: Strike Blind
description: Renders the subject completely blind for the duration of the spell. The subject suffers all penalties for total darkness (-10 to attack rolls, -2 to active defenses, Move halved).

name: Strike Deaf
description: Renders the subject completely deaf for the duration of the spell. The subject fails all hearing perception rolls automatically and cannot hear spoken commands or spell incantations.

name: Strike Dumb
description: Renders the subject completely unable to speak or make vocal sounds for the duration of the spell. The subject cannot speak, shout, or cast spells requiring spoken incantations.

name: Choke
description: Constricts the subject's windpipe, preventing breathing. The subject suffers 1 point of fatigue or suffocation damage per second while choking and cannot speak.

name: Agony
description: Subjects the target to excruciating, unbearable pain for the duration. The subject is completely incapacitated and can take no actions other than writhe or scream unless he makes a Will-5 roll each turn.

name: Ambidexterity
description: Grants the subject the Ambidexterity advantage for the duration. Eliminates the off-hand penalty (-4 to attack or skill) when using the off-hand.

name: Balance
description: Grants the subject perfect balance. The subject gets +4 to DX rolls to keep his footing, walk tightropes, or stand on slippery or moving surfaces, and ignores penalties for narrow footing.

name: Boost Strength
description: Increases the subject's ST by 1 point per energy spent (maximum +3 ST) for the duration of the spell.

name: Boost Dexterity
description: Increases the subject's DX by 1 point per energy spent (maximum +3 DX) for the duration of the spell.

name: Boost Health
description: Increases the subject's HT by 1 point per energy spent (maximum +3 HT) for the duration of the spell. Does not increase current HP.

name: Might
description: Increases the subject's ST by +1 for every 2 points of energy spent, up to a maximum bonus of +5 ST. Increases basic lift, melee damage, and HP capacity.

name: Grace
description: Increases the subject's DX by +1 for every 2 points of energy spent, up to a maximum bonus of +5 DX. Increases all DX-based skills and Basic Speed.

name: Vigor
description: Increases the subject's HT by +1 for every 2 points of energy spent, up to a maximum bonus of +5 HT. Increases resistance rolls and Basic Speed.

name: Enfeeblement
description: Reduces the subject's ST by 1 point for every 2 energy spent, up to a maximum reduction of -5 ST. Reduces weapon damage and basic lift.

name: Cadence
description: Regulates the subject's heartbeat, breathing, and physical exertion, halving fatigue lost from long-distance running, marching, or heavy labor.

name: Corpulence
prerequisites: Alter Body or 3 Body Control spells
description: Causes the subject to gain temporary fatty body mass, giving the Overweight or Fat disadvantage for the duration (-1 to -2 to DX in tight situations, +1 to +2 to HT rolls vs cold).

name: Gauntness
description: Causes the subject to lose body fat rapidly, appearing emaciated and thin (Skinny disadvantage). Reduces weight and gives -2 to ST when resisting knockback or slams.

name: Hair Growth
description: Causes hair on the subject's head, face, or body to grow rapidly by up to 12 inches per casting. The growth is natural human hair and remains permanently.

name: Haircut
description: Instantly trims, styles, or shaves hair on the subject's body or head into any desired length or style without scissors or razor.

name: Hinder
description: Reduces the subject's Move and Dodge scores by 1 point per energy spent (maximum -4) for the duration of the spell.

name: Rooted Feet
description: Binds the subject's feet firmly to the floor or ground. The subject cannot move from the spot, halves Dodge score, and suffers -2 to melee attacks. Subject may attempt a ST-5 roll each turn to break free.

name: Sensitize
description: Makes the subject's nervous system extremely sensitive to pain and touch. All pain penalties and shock penalties suffered by the subject are doubled for the duration.

name: Touch
description: Simulates a physical touch or tap on any part of the subject's body, as if brushed by a hand or finger. Does no damage but can distract or startle.

name: Resist Pain
description: Grants the subject complete immunity to shock penalties and pain-based stun or incapacitation for the duration (High Pain Threshold advantage).

name: Resist Poison
description: Grants the subject +3 to HT rolls to resist poisons, toxins, and venoms, and halves all poison damage taken while active.

name: Alter Visage
description: Changes the facial features, skin tone, hair color, and eye color of the subject to match any human face desired. Grants +4 to Disguise skill when imitating someone.

name: Alter Voice
description: Alters the pitch, vocal cords, and accent of the subject's voice to sound like any target person or voice type. Grants +3 to Mimicry or Disguise when speaking.

name: Alter Body
description: Modifies the entire body shape, height, build, and features of the subject to match any humanoid form of similar mass. Does not change racial stats or species.

name: Shrink
description: Shrinks the subject's physical size and gear, reducing Size Modifier (SM) by 1 for every 2 energy spent. Halves ST for every -2 SM reduction.

name: Enlargement
description: Increases the subject's physical size and gear, increasing Size Modifier (SM) by +1 per 3 energy spent. Increases ST by +50% per +1 SM.

name: Reflexes
description: Grants the subject Combat Reflexes advantage for the duration (+1 to all active defenses, +2 to recover from surprise/stun, +1 initiative).

name: Sense Foes
description: Tells the caster whether any individuals in the area hold hostile intent toward him, or toward a person or object he specifies. Does not identify the foes or reveal their plans, but gives a general impression of the degree of hostility (e.g., 'annoyed,' 'murderous'). The area is a circle centered on the caster (or subject). Will not detect hostility directed at anyone other than the specified target.

name: Sense Emotion
description: Tells the caster the dominant emotion currently felt by one subject (fear, anger, love, greed, joy, etc.). If the subject fails a resistance roll by 5 or more, the caster also gets a general idea of the reason for the emotion.

name: Truthsayer
description: Tells whether the subject is telling a deliberate lie or a partial truth during speech. Does not reveal what the truth actually is if the subject is lying, only whether the statement made was intentionally deceptive. Does not work against unintentional falsehoods (e.g., if the subject genuinely believes a lie to be true).

name: Mind-Reading
description: Reads the current surface thoughts and mental state of a sapient subject upon winning a Quick Contest of skill vs. Will. Allows the caster to listen in on internal monologue and immediate conscious thoughts. The subject is unaware of the attempt unless the caster critically fails.

name: Mind-Search
description: Probes deep into the subject's memory and subconscious mind. Caster can search for specific memories, secrets, skills, or forgotten events. Caster must win a Quick Contest of skill vs. Will; each minute of probing allows one specific question or topic to be searched.

name: Mind-Sending
description: Project mental thoughts, words, or simple images directly into the mind of a subject. The communication is one-way (caster to subject) unless Telepathy or Mind-Reading is also used. Willing subjects do not resist; unwilling subjects roll Will to block the communication.

name: Telepathy
description: Establishes a two-way mental communication link with the subject, allowing instant, silent conversation regardless of language barriers. Allows exchange of spoken thoughts, concepts, and sensory impressions.

name: Hide Thoughts
description: Protects the subject's surface thoughts, mind, and emotional state against telepathy, Mind-Reading, Mind-Search, Truthsayer, or emotion detection. Mind-readers suffer a -5 penalty to skill when trying to probe or read the subject.

name: Borrow Language
description: Temporarily copies comprehension and fluency of a language known by the subject into the caster's mind. Does not remove or affect the subject's ability to speak or understand the language.

name: Borrow Skill
description: Temporarily copies one mental or physical skill known by the subject, allowing the caster to use it at the subject's effective skill level (up to caster's own IQ/DX limits + 2). Caster must remain within 10 yards of the subject.

name: Gift of Tongues
description: Grants the subject Native fluency in both speaking and understanding any spoken language they hear or attempt to speak while the spell is active.

name: Gift of Letters
description: Grants the subject Native literacy in any written language or script they examine while the spell is active, allowing them to read and write fluently.

name: Relay
description: Allows the caster to use another person as a relay station to cast Information or Communication spells at a distant target that the relay person can see or touch.

name: Soul Rider
description: Perceives the world through the subject's senses (sight, hearing, touch, taste, smell) as if sitting inside their mind. The caster loses perception of his own body while riding the subject's senses.

name: Dream Viewing
description: Observes the dreams of a sleeping subject, viewing them like a mental moving picture. Caster can gain insight into the subject's fears, desires, or sub-conscious thoughts.

name: Dream Sending
description: Projects a specific message, scene, or nightmare into the dreams of a sleeping subject. The dream will be remembered clearly by the subject upon waking up.

name: Dream Walking
description: Enters physically or mentally into the subject's dreamscape, interacting directly with the subject's dream persona and shaping the dream environment.

name: Compel Truth
description: Forces the subject to speak only the absolute truth. The subject cannot lie, misdirect, or withhold information when asked direct questions.

name: Compel Lie
description: Forces the subject to lie whenever they speak. The subject is physically unable to speak true statements for the duration of the spell.

name: Borrow Body
description: Temporarily takes full physical control of the subject's body while sending the subject's mind into a dormant, unconscious state. Caster's original body lies comatose.

name: Possession
description: Takes complete control of the subject's body and mind for 24 hours. The caster inhabits the host body completely, using its physical attributes while retaining caster's mental skills.

name: Permanent Possession
description: Permanently transfers the caster's consciousness into the target host body. The host's original soul is evicted or destroyed. Caster's original body dies upon completion.

name: Exchange Bodies
description: Swaps the minds/souls of two living subjects (or caster and subject) permanently. Each retains their original mental statistics and skills in the new physical body.

name: Great Voice
description: Amplifies the subject's voice tremendously so it can be heard clearly up to a mile away without distortion, shouting, or hoarseness.

name: Retain Skills
description: Prevents memory loss, amnesia, or skill degradation caused by brain damage, aging, or magic. Preserves full skill levels.

name: Communication
description: Allows smooth, clear communication across distances or language barriers between willingness subjects linked by the spell.

name: Emotion Control
description: Instills a specific strong emotion (fear, rage, love, sorrow, calm) into the subject's mind, altering their immediate behavior accordingly.

name: Sway Emotion
description: Projects a single emotional state (e.g., panic, courage, hostility, serenity) over an entire crowd or area of effect.

name: Mass Sway
description: Sways the emotions and inclinations of large masses or military units over a vast area.

name: Peacebrother
description: Suppresses all violent impulses and anger within the area. Those affected cannot initiate attacks or violent acts.

name: Insensitize
description: Numbs the subject's emotional and physical sensitivity, granting High Pain Threshold and immunity to fear/emotion spells.

name: Presence
description: Projects a powerful aura of authority, majesty, or terror that grants +3 to reaction rolls or intimidation checks.

name: Vexation
description: Fills the subject with irrational annoyance, impatience, and irritability, giving -2 to DX and IQ tasks requiring concentration.

name: Seek Earth
description: Tells the caster the direction and distance to the nearest significant vein or deposit of any one type of earth, stone, or metal. The caster names the target substance while casting. Modifiers: -1 per mile of distance to the target; -3 if the caster does not have a sample of the desired metal or stone in hand (no penalty for ordinary soil, sand, or common stone).

name: Shape Earth
initialCost: 1 per 25 cu. ft. (cu. yd. of soil)
description: Moves earth (soil, sand, or clay) around and shapes it into any form desired. Soft soil or sand moved by this spell becomes firm enough to walk on or stand as a mound or dike. Stone requires double energy cost (1 per 12.5 cu. ft.) and takes longer to shape. If the shaped earth is structurally stable (like a simple wall or mound), it remains in that shape permanently after the spell duration ends; unstable shapes collapse when duration expires.

name: Earth to Air
initialCost: 5 per 25 cu. ft. (1 cu. yd. of earth)
description: Transforms earth, soil, sand, or stone into fresh, breathable air. Essential for trapped miners or diggers. Converts 1 cubic yard of earth or rock per 5 points of energy into air at normal atmospheric pressure.

name: Earth to Stone
initialCost: 3 per cu. yd. (min 3; double for metal)
description: Transforms soil, sand, or clay into solid stone. Double cost (6 per cu. yd.) to transform soil or stone into simple metal (like iron, bronze, or lead). Precious metals (gold, silver) cannot be created with this spell.

name: Create Earth
initialCost: 2 per cu. yd. (1 per cu. yd. from mud)
description: Creates solid, natural earth out of nothing (must touch the ground or existing earth) or solidifies mud into good firm earth permanently. Cannot be created inside a living creature.

name: Stone to Earth
description: Converts any stone or gemstone into simple, soft earth or soil. Must affect a whole block or rock section. Useful for mining or breaking through stone walls.

name: Earth Vision
initialCost: 2 per 10 yards of depth to cast
description: See through the earth – to find caves, bodies of ore, buried treasure, entombed victims, etc. Earth and uncut stone (up to 50 yards deep) are transparent to the subject, wherever he looks. Metal is not transparent; neither are cut stone, bricks, etc. Thus, this spell won’t let you look through castle walls. This is also a Knowledge spell.

name: Predict Earthquakes
description: Predicts whether a natural or magical earthquake will occur within a specified radius (up to 10 miles) in the next 24 hours. A critical success gives exact timing, epicenter, and Richter scale severity.

name: Essential Earth
description: Creates magical, super-fertile Earth. Plants grown in Essential Earth grow at three times normal speed and yield three times normal crop output. Essential Earth is completely immune to non-magical soil blights and diseases.

name: Sand Jet
description: Shoots a jet of abrasive sand from the caster's hand. Treat as a ranged attack with Acc 3, Max range equal to energy spent in yards. Deals 1d-1 crushing damage per energy spent and blinds target if struck in the face (unless HT roll succeeds).

name: Mud Jet
description: Fires a stream of dense mud from the caster's hands. Range equal to energy spent in yards. Deals 1d crushing damage per energy spent and blinds/clogs eyes and mouth of target unless HT roll is made.

name: Stone Missile
description: Forms a sharp rock in the caster's hand and hurls it at a target. Deals 1d+1 crushing damage per energy point invested (up to 3d+3 for 3 energy points). Half Damage range 20, Max range 40, Acc 2.

name: Rain of Stones
description: Causes a barrage of heavy stones and rock fragments to rain down continuously over the area of effect from midair. All subjects in the area suffer 1d crushing damage per turn.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: Petrifies a living subject and all carried gear into solid stone permanently upon failing a HT resistance roll. The subject remains conscious in a frozen state unless saved by Stone to Flesh.

name: Stone to Flesh
prerequisites: Magery 2, Flesh to Stone, Stone to Earth
description: Reverses petrification, restoring a petrified statue back into a living, conscious flesh-and-blood person. If parts of the statue were damaged or missing while petrified, the restored subject suffers corresponding crippling injuries or lost HP.

name: Entombment
description: Opens the ground beneath the target's feet and encases them solid in earth or stone deep underground. Subject begins suffocating immediately unless rescued or freed. Caster can reverse entombment for 6 energy points.

name: Earth Wall
initialCost: 3 per yard of wall length (wall is 3 yds high, 1 yd thick)
description: Creates a sturdy wall of solid packed earth or stone 3 yards high and 1 yard thick along the border of the affected hexes. Has DR 10 and 30 HP per yard of length.

name: Move Earth
description: Excavates or shifts massive quantities of earth, sand, or loose rock automatically at a rate of 10 cubic yards per minute per energy point spent. Ideal for engineering trenches, moats, or canal excavations.

name: Walk Through Earth
description: Allows the subject to walk through solid earth, soil, sand, or unworked rock as if it were air at Move 2. Subject can breathe normally while inside the earth. Metal, cut stone, or castle masonry blocks movement.

name: Quake
description: Causes a localized earthquake in the area of effect. Structures take structural damage every turn, and all creatures in the area must roll DX-4 every turn or fall prone and suffer 1d crushing damage.

name: Volcano
description: Opens a volcanic vent in the ground, shooting lava, ash, and magma into the air. Deals 3d burning damage to everything in the area and fills surrounding air with toxic suffocating fumes.

name: Steelwrap
description: Causes metal ore or metal objects touching the subject to spring up and wrap tightly around their body and limbs, immobilizing them completely. Subject must win a Contest of ST vs spell skill to break free.

name: Earth Spikes
prerequisites: Shape Earth and Earth to Stone
description: Causes razor-sharp stone spikes to erupt from earth or stone terrain in the area. Deals 2d impaling damage to anyone standing in the area who fails a Dodge roll, and turns the terrain into severe bad footing.

name: Alter Terrain
description: Permanently changes the top layer of ground (turning rocky terrain into smooth soil, or flat ground into rough terrain with gullies and ridges). Modifies movement costs and cover modifiers in combat.

name: Enchant
timeToCast: Special (Slow and Sure: 1 day per 1 energy; Ceremonial: 1 sec per energy)
initialCost: Varies by enchantment being cast (minimum 100 energy)
prerequisites: Magery 2 and at least 1 spell from each of 10 different colleges
description: This is the master spell required to create permanent magic items. It is never cast alone; it must be cast simultaneously with the spell(s) being embedded into the item. Enchantment can be performed using two methods: Quick and Dirty (requires a circle of mages providing all required energy in a single ceremony taking minutes/hours) or Slow and Sure (a single enchanter or team working 8 hours a day, contributing 1 energy point per person per day until the total energy cost is met; any interruption ruins the work). On a critical failure during enchantment, roll on the Magic Item Bad Stuff Table (p. 222).

name: Accuracy
initialCost: 250 for +1 accuracy, 1,000 for +2, 5,000 for +3 (Divide energy cost by 10 for missile ammunition)
prerequisites: Enchant and at least 5 Air spells
description: Enchants a weapon (melee or missile) or missile ammunition to grant a bonus to the wielder's effective attack skill when using that weapon. The bonus can be +1, +2, or +3. Does not affect damage. When cast on missile ammunition (arrows, crossbow bolts, sling stones, bullets), the energy cost is divided by 10, but each enchanted projectile is destroyed upon use.

name: Puissance
initialCost: 250 for +1 damage, 1,000 for +2, 5,000 for +3 (Divide energy cost by 10 for missile ammunition)
prerequisites: Enchant and at least 5 Earth spells
description: Enchants a weapon or missile ammunition to deal extra damage on every successful strike. Adds +1, +2, or +3 to the weapon's damage roll. This additional damage is of the same type as the weapon's normal damage (cutting, impaling, crushing, etc.). Divide energy cost by 10 for individual missile ammunition.

name: Deflect
initialCost: 100 for +1 DB, 500 for +2 DB, 2,000 for +3 DB, 5,000 for +4 DB, 10,000 for +5 DB
description: Enchants a piece of armor, a shield, or clothing to grant a Defense Bonus (+1 to +5 DB) to all active defenses (Block, Dodge, Parry) of the wearer/user against all attacks coming from the front or defended side. The bonus stacks with shield DB and other defense modifiers.

name: Fortify
initialCost: 50 for +1 DR, 100 for +2 DR, 400 for +3 DR, 800 for +4 DR, 1,600 for +5 DR
description: Enchants clothing, armor, or a shield to increase its base Damage Resistance (DR) by +1 to +5 points. The added DR protects any location covered by the enchanted item and stacks with natural DR and base armor DR.

name: Power
initialCost: 500 per point of energy dedicated to powering the item
description: Enchants an item so that it provides a dedicated pool of energy (1 to 5+ points) to power its own internal magic spells or reduce the energy cost required from the user when activating the item's spells. The item recovers its spent energy pool at the rate of 1 point per hour.

name: Staff
description: Enchants a wooden staff, cane, wand, or rod to serve as a physical and magical extension of the caster's arm. When held by the owner, touch spells can be delivered through the tip of the staff at the staff's full reach. Distance penalties for spellcasting are calculated from the tip of the staff rather than the caster's hand. Only the wizard who created the staff (or for whom it was attuned) can use its special properties.

name: Scroll
timeToCast: Special (1 day per 10 energy of the recorded spell, minimum 1 day)
initialCost: Equal to 33% of the energy cost to cast the embedded spell (minimum 10 energy)
prerequisites: Enchant and the spell to be recorded on the scroll
description: Writes a single-use magical spell onto a piece of parchment, vellum, or paper. Anyone who can read the language in which the scroll was written (or who casts Read Magic) can activate the spell by reading the scroll aloud, regardless of whether they possess Magery or know the spell. Reading the scroll casts the spell using the scroll creator's skill level. Reading destroys the magical writing on the scroll.

name: Cornucopia
initialCost: 100 times the cost of a single item created (minimum 100 energy)
prerequisites: Enchant and Create Object (or Create Earth/Water/Food depending on item)
description: Enchants a container (bag, quiver, pouch, barrel, quiver, scabbard) so that whenever an item normally stored inside it is removed, an identical replacement item instantly manifests inside the container. Commonly used for endless quivers of arrows, endless pouches of sling stones, or endless coins/rations. Items drawn from a Cornucopia vanish if separated from the user for more than a few minutes unless specified otherwise.

name: Speed (Weapon)
initialCost: 1,000 (+1 weapon attack speed / reduces ready time)
description: Enchants a weapon so that it responds faster in combat. Reduces the required readiness time of the weapon by 1 turn (e.g., a weapon that normally takes 1 turn to ready after swinging becomes instantly readied), or gives +1 to effective skill when making Fast-Draw tests with that weapon.

name: Speed (Armor)
initialCost: 500 per +1 Move and Dodge granted to wearer (max +3)
description: Enchants a suit of armor or clothing so that it increases the wearer's Movement rate and Dodge score by +1 to +3 without increasing encumbrance.

name: Grace
description: Enchants a worn item (ring, amulet, gloves, boots, armor) to grant the wearer a permanent +1, +2, or +3 bonus to Dexterity (DX) while worn.

name: Might
description: Enchants a worn item (belt, gauntlets, ring, armor) to grant the wearer a permanent +1, +2, or +3 bonus to Strength (ST) and Basic Lift while worn.

name: Wisdom
description: Enchants a worn item (circlet, headband, ring, amulet) to grant the wearer a permanent +1, +2, or +3 bonus to Intelligence (IQ) and IQ-based skills while worn.

name: Lighten
initialCost: 100 per 25% weight reduction (max 75% reduction for 300 energy)
description: Enchants an object (armor, weapon, shield, backpack, container) to permanently reduce its physical weight by 25%, 50%, or 75% without reducing its structural strength, Damage Resistance, or effectiveness.

name: Password
description: Attaches a spoken or gestured password to another enchanted item. The item's magic remains inert and completely inactive until the correct password is spoken/performed by the user.

name: Link
description: Links the activation of two or more separate spells embedded in the same item or across multiple items, causing one spell to automatically trigger when specific conditions are met or when the other spell is activated.

name: Name
description: Gives a magic item a secret True Name. Anyone who knows the item's True Name gains +2 to all spell rolls directed at controlling or modifying the item, and can activate its powers even if not normally attuned.

name: Delay
description: Enchants an item so that a spell embedded in it does not take effect immediately upon casting/activation, but is instead held in stasis until a preset trigger condition occurs (e.g., touched by an enemy, opened, stepped on).

name: Hex
description: Attaches a permanent curse or negative effect to an enchanted item. Anyone who picks up, wears, or uses the hexed item suffers the specified curse until the item is cleansed via Remove Enchantment or Dispel Magic.

name: Limit
initialCost: 50 (or -20% of total energy cost of item)
description: Places a strict restriction on who can use an enchanted item (e.g., 'Only a dwarf', 'Only a good-aligned character', 'Only someone with Bloodlust'). Reduces the required energy cost of other enchantments placed on the item by 20%.

name: Talisman
initialCost: 50 for temporary single-use talisman, 500 for permanent reusable talisman
prerequisites: Enchant and the spell to be embedded
description: Embeds a non-Enchantment spell into a portable object (amulet, ring, coin, gem). A temporary talisman can be used once by anyone holding it to cast the embedded spell without spending FP. A permanent talisman allows the user to cast the embedded spell repeatedly by providing the spell's normal FP cost.

name: Powerstone
timeToCast: Special (Quick and Dirty or Slow and Sure)
initialCost: 20 for 1st point of FP capacity, scaling up non-linearly for higher capacities (e.g., 20 per point up to capacity P; 20*P^(1.28) energy)
prerequisites: Enchant and 1 spell from each of 5 colleges
description: Enchants a precious or semi-precious gemstone to store magical energy (FP) that any wizard holding the stone can draw upon to cast spells. Powerstones recharge naturally at the rate of 1 point of energy per day when kept at least 6 feet away from other Powerstones.

name: Manastone
initialCost: 5 per point of energy capacity stored in stone
description: Enchants a gemstone to hold a fixed amount of magical energy. Unlike a Powerstone, a Manastone can be charged quickly by mages pumping FP into it, but once its energy is drawn out, the stone is permanently drained and cannot recharge on its own unless re-enchanted.

name: Draw Power
prerequisites: Enchant and Steal Energy or Conduct Power
description: Enchants a device or conduit allowing a wizard to draw electrical or mechanical energy from technological sources (generators, power grids, engines, batteries) and convert it directly into FP energy for casting spells.

name: Loyal Sword
description: Enchants a weapon so that if dropped, disarmed, or thrown, it automatically flies back to the owner's hand at Move 10 on the owner's next turn. If blocked or held by someone else, it pulls against them with ST 15.

name: Quick-Aim
description: Enchants a ranged weapon (bow, crossbow, gun) or scope so that taking an Aim maneuver grants double the weapon's normal Accuracy (Acc) bonus in half the usual aim time.

name: Shatterproof
initialCost: 150 for small item (up to 5 lbs), 400 for medium item (up to 50 lbs), 1,000 for large item
prerequisites: Enchant and Earth to Stone or Find Weakness
description: Renders an object completely immune to accidental breakage, weapon breakage tests, shattering, chips, and structural fatigue. The item cannot be broken except by magical disintegrating attacks or extreme enchanted violence.

name: Dancing Weapon
description: Enchants a weapon to float in midair and fight autonomously on behalf of its owner. On command, the weapon attacks designated targets using the skill level of the enchanter (or owner) at Move 5, leaving the owner's hands completely free to fight with other weapons or cast spells.

name: Weapon Blessing
description: Enchants a weapon so that it inflicts normal damage against dematerialized, insubstantial, or spirit entities (ghosts, specters, demons) and bypasses non-magical Damage Resistance granted by supernatural traits.

name: Scryguard
description: Enchants an item or location to protect it against all forms of magical scrying, information spells, divinations, and remote sensing. Anyone attempting to scry on the protected subject must win a Quick Contest against the Scryguard spell.

name: Suspend Enchantment
duration: Temporary (1 hour per energy spent) or Permanent if cast with Enchant
initialCost: 10 to 50 energy depending on power of target item
description: Temporarily suppresses all magical properties and active enchantments of a target magic item, turning it into a completely ordinary mundane object for the duration of the spell. Must win a Quick Contest against the item's enchantment skill.

name: Remove Enchantment
initialCost: Equal to 50% of the original energy cost used to enchant the target item
description: Permanently strips away all enchantments and magical spells from an object, destroying its magic and restoring it to a normal mundane item. Must win a Quick Contest against the highest spell skill embedded in the item.

name: Great Power
initialCost: 2,000 per extra point of energy generated/stored beyond normal caps
description: Extends the power capacity of magic items and artifacts beyond standard limits, enabling major legendary artifacts and massive mana reservoirs.

name: Ignite Fire
description: Produces a spot of intense heat. It will ignite a fire on a flammable subject (paper, cloth, dry wood, etc.) if the subject is flammable enough to ignite at that temperature. It cannot be cast directly inside a living creature, but will ignite clothing or hair. A critical success ignites the target instantly and thoroughly.

name: Create Fire
description: Fills the area of effect with a roaring, fuel-less flame. It inflicts 1d-1 burning damage per second to anyone or anything within the area. Flammable objects inside will catch fire. Moving the fire requires Shape Fire.

name: Shape Fire
description: Allows the caster to alter the shape, size, or location of any existing fire. The flame can be moved at Move 5 as long as it remains within the caster's line of sight. It can be made to leap over obstacles or contract to concentrate heat.

name: Extinguish Fire
description: Instantly puts out all non-magical fires in the area of effect. Against magical fire, the caster must win a Quick Contest against the skill of the spell that created the fire.

name: Fireball
initialCost: 1 to 3 (deals 1d burning damage per energy spent)
description: Creates a sphere of flame in the caster's hand. When thrown (using Innate Attack (Beam or Projectile) or DX-4), it deals 1d burning damage per energy point spent (maximum 3d for 3 energy). Flammable targets may catch fire. Range 1/2D 25, Max 50, Acc 1.

name: Explosive Fireball
initialCost: Up to 2x Magery per sec (1d per 2 energy)
description: Creates an explosive sphere of fire. Upon impact, it explodes, dealing 1d burning damage per 2 energy points to the target and all adjacent subjects. The damage drops off with distance (divided by 3x distance in yards from impact point). Range 1/2D 25, Max 50, Acc 1.

name: Heat
description: Raises the temperature of an object or area by 20°F per energy point spent per minute. Can be used to warm clothing, melt ice, boil water, or heat weapons to make them uncomfortable or impossible to hold.

name: Cold
description: Lowers the temperature of an object or area by 20°F per energy point spent per minute. Can freeze liquids, preserve food, or cause cold-based distress/damage over time.

name: Resist Cold
description: Renders the subject completely immune to natural cold weather, freezing conditions, and frostbite. Does not protect against falling ice, physical ice weapons, or crushing ice damage.

name: Resist Fire
description: Renders the subject and carried gear completely immune to heat, fire, and burning attacks. The subject can walk through infernos unharmed. Does not protect against electrical energy, lasers, or crushing damage from falling burning debris.

name: Deflect Energy
description: Deflects one incoming energy attack (Fireball, Lightning bolt, beam weapon projectile, dragon breath, etc.) harmlessly away from the caster. Counts as an active parry in combat.

name: Slow Fire
description: Causes all fires within the area of effect to burn at half speed, consuming fuel twice as slowly and dealing half burning damage per second.

name: Fast Fire
description: Causes all fires within the area to burn twice as fast, consuming fuel twice as quickly and inflicting double burning damage per second.

name: Essential Fire
description: Creates magical 'essential fire' that burns three times as hot as ordinary flame, inflicts 3d-3 burning damage per second, and cannot be extinguished by water (only by Extinguish Fire or lack of air).

name: Flame Jet
initialCost: 1 to 3 (1d burning damage per energy point)
description: Shoots a continuous stream of fire from the caster's hand. Reaches up to 3 yards. Requires a roll against Innate Attack (Beam) to hit. Deals 1d burning damage per energy point spent (max 3d).

name: Ring of Fire
description: Creates a circular curtain or wall of flame along the perimeter of the area of effect. Anyone crossing the ring suffers 1d+2 burning damage.

name: Fire Cloud
description: Fills the area with a burning cloud of glowing embers and hot gas. Anyone inside suffers 1d burning damage per second and must roll vs HT every turn or choke from smoke.

name: Rain of Fire
description: Causes fiery droplets to rain down over an entire area. Everyone in the area takes burning damage every second based on energy spent (2 energy = 1d/sec, 4 energy = 2d/sec, 6 energy = 3d/sec).

name: Flaming Weapon
description: Envelops any melee or missile weapon in magical flames. Adds +2 burning damage to every successful strike that hits a target. Flammable targets struck may catch fire.

name: Flaming Armor
description: Covers the subject's armor or clothing in harmless protective flames. Anyone hitting the subject in close combat or grappling them takes 1d-1 burning damage automatically.

name: Phantom Flame
description: Creates the visual appearance and crackling sound of fire without any heat or actual burning capability. Useful for intimidation or distraction.

name: Warmth
description: Keeps the subject comfortably warm in cold environments without generating visible flame or light.

name: Freeze
description: Rapidly drains heat from a living target. Target rolls vs HT to resist. If target fails, they suffer 2d cold damage and are encased in a shell of frost, causing -2 DX and halving Move.

name: Burning Touch
description: Inflicts 1d burning damage per energy point spent (max 3d) upon a successful melee touch attack. Ignores metallic DR unless insulated.

name: Fireproof
description: Makes an inanimate object completely immune to fire, heat, and catching fire for 1 day.

name: Smoke
description: Fills the area with thick black smoke that obscures vision (-4 to all vision rolls and attacks through smoke) and causes coughing unless protected.

name: Summon Elemental (Fire)
description: Summons a Fire Elemental from the Elemental Plane of Fire. The elemental must be controlled using Control Elemental or negotiated with.

name: Control Elemental (Fire)
initialCost: 3 for Small, 5 for Medium, 7 for Large, 9 for Huge
description: Gains complete mental control over a Fire Elemental upon winning a Quick Contest of Skill vs Elemental's Will.

name: Create Elemental (Fire)
description: Creates a loyal Fire Elemental out of existing flames. The elemental is permanently bound to obey the caster.

name: Lend Appetite
description: Transfers hunger from the caster (or another subject) to the target. For every point of energy spent, the target feels 1 level of hunger higher (or gains a normal appetite if lacking one), while the donor's hunger is reduced by an equivalent amount. Useful for making a fussy eater hungry or forcing someone to overeat.

name: Steal Appetite
description: Steals the subject's appetite and transfers it to the caster. The target feels completely full and disinterested in food, while the caster gains a healthy appetite. If used on a starving target, the caster experiences intense hunger pains (-1 to DX and IQ).

name: Seek Food
description: Gives the direction and approximate distance to the nearest source of edible food. The caster can specify a particular type of food (e.g., 'ripe berries', 'fresh venison', 'clean bread'); if unspecified, it locates the closest wholesome, edible matter.

name: Test Food
description: Determines whether a batch or dish of food/drink is safe to consume. Reveals if it is spoiled, rotten, poisonous, or contaminated, and identifies the general nature of the poison or spoilage present.

name: Season
description: Improves or alters the flavor of food or drink. Can make bland or unappetizing food taste delicious, or add specific spices and flavorings (salt, pepper, herbs, sweetness) according to the caster's desire. Does not make poisonous or rotten food safe, but makes it palatable.

name: Decay
description: Causes organic food matter to rot and spoil immediately. Fresh food becomes stale, rotten, or moldy, making it inedible and potentially poisonous (requires HT roll to avoid nausea if consumed). Does not affect living beings.

name: Preserve Food
description: Protects fresh or prepared food from natural decay, rot, mold, and insect infestation. The food remains as fresh as the moment it was cast upon for as long as it remains untouched. Once eating begins, natural decay resumes.

name: Purify Food
description: Removes all poisons, rot, decay, bacteria, and toxins from a quantity of food or drink, restoring spoiled or poisoned food to wholesome, safe, and nutritious condition.

name: Prepare Game
description: Instantly skins, guts, cleans, and butchers a dead animal or fish, separating meat, hide, and bones cleanly and ready for cooking or tanning. Eliminates the need for Survival or Cooking rolls for dressing game.

name: Cook
description: Instantly cooks raw food (meat, vegetables, grains) to perfection without needing fire, pots, or fuel. The food emerges hot, thoroughly cooked, and delicious.

name: Create Food
initialCost: 2 per meal (1 lb of wholesome food)
description: Creates simple, highly nutritious food (like dry bread, hardcheese, or porridge) out of thin air. The created food is wholesome and provides full nutritional value for 1 meal per 2 energy points spent.

name: Essential Food
description: Creates concentrated, magical food. One meal of Essential Food satisfies all nutritional and energy requirements for a full day (24 hours) for one person, restoring 1 extra FP upon consumption.

name: Water to Wine
description: Transforms plain water into good-quality wine (or ale/beer if caster prefers). The resulting beverage is alcoholic and tastes genuine.

name: Wine to Water
description: Transforms wine, ale, spirits, or any alcoholic beverage into pure, fresh drinking water, completely neutralizing alcohol content.

name: Distill
description: Separates liquids or concentrates alcoholic beverages, increasing proof/potency or separating water from dissolved mixtures, syrups, or spirits.

name: Ferment
description: Instantly ferments fruit juices, grain mashes, or milk into wine, beer, cider, or cheese, bypassing weeks of aging.

name: Banquet
description: Conjures a magnificent feast complete with fine tables, dishes, roast meats, delicacies, and vintage wines sufficient to feed everyone within the area of effect.

name: Poison Food
description: Secretly converts wholesome food or drink into a deadly poison (deals 2d toxic damage unless HT roll is made). The food retains its normal appearance, smell, and taste.

name: Far-Tasting
description: Allows the caster to taste any food or liquid within sight as if consuming it directly, checking for flavor, ingredients, or poison without ingesting it.

name: Monk's Banquet
description: Sustains the subject on a single mouthful of bread and water (or any tiny morsel) for a full 24 hours without feeling hunger, suffering starvation, or losing strength.

name: Seek Gate
description: Tells the caster the location of the nearest interdimensional or spatial gate, portal, or rift within 1 mile. If none is within 1 mile, the spell fails.

name: Scry Gate
description: Allows the caster to look through a known gate to see what is on the other side before stepping through, without actually opening or activating the gate. Shows a 10-yard radius around the exit point.

name: Control Gate
description: Gives the caster temporary control over an existing gate. The caster may change the gate's destination (if it is a variable gate), open or close it, or lock it against use by others for the duration.

name: Dispel Gate
description: Permanently closes and destroys a natural or magical gate. The caster must win a Quick Contest against the skill of the original gate's creator (or against skill 15 for natural gates).

name: Create Gate
prerequisites: Magery 3, Control Gate, and at least 5 other Gate spells
description: Creates a doorway or portal connecting two locations in the same plane or across different planes. Anyone or anything stepping through the portal instantly travels to the destination. The destination must be known to the caster.

name: Planar Summons
description: Summons a creature, spirit, or entity from a specific other plane of existence to the caster's location. Each plane requires a separate version of this spell as a distinct skill. Does not grant control over the summoned entity unless combined with appropriate control spells.

name: Plane Shift
description: Transports the caster and all carried equipment instantly to another specified plane of existence. Requires a Body Sense roll upon arrival to avoid mental disorientation and physical imbalance for 1d seconds.

name: Plane Shift Other
description: Transports another subject (and carried gear) against their will or with their consent to another plane of existence. Unwilling subjects roll vs. Will to resist.

name: Teleport
initialCost: Varies by distance (5 for up to 10 miles, 10 for up to 100 miles, +5 per tenfold distance)
prerequisites: Magery 2, IQ 13+, and 10 other Gate spells
description: Instantly moves the caster and clothing/carried load (up to Extra Heavy Encumbrance) to any known location on the same plane. Distance penalties apply to spell skill (-1 at 10 yds, -2 at 100 yds, -3 at 1 mile, -4 at 10 miles, -5 at 100 miles, etc.). Blind teleporting carries severe risks of materializing inside solid objects.

name: Teleport Other
description: Instantly teleports another creature or object to a destination specified by the caster. Unwilling targets resist with Will. Target must make a Body Sense roll upon arrival.

name: Blink
description: Caster teleports 1d yards in a random direction (or directional choice if critical success) as an active defense against an incoming attack. Completely avoids any physical or energy strike if successful.

name: Blink Other
description: Teleports a ally or enemy 1d yards away in a random direction to dodge an incoming attack or push an attacker away from a hit.

name: Autoteleport
description: Triggers an automatic instant teleportation to a pre-designated safe haven whenever the caster suffers lethal damage, is stunned, or enters mortal danger.

name: Great Teleport
description: Teleports the caster and an unlimited number of willing allies/subjects over any distance anywhere in the world or solar system without distance skill penalties.

name: Sanctuary
description: Pockets the caster and up to 3 companions into an extradimensional pocket dimension safe from all external physical attacks and detection for the duration.

name: Timeport
initialCost: 20 + 5 per decade traveled into past or future
prerequisites: Magery 3, Teleport, and at least 6 Gate spells
description: Transports the caster forward or backward through time to the exact geographic location they currently occupy in a different temporal era.

name: Timeport Other
description: Sends another target forward or backward through time against their will or with consent.

name: Time Slip
description: Steps forward 1 to 5 seconds into the immediate future, disappearing from existence during those combat rounds and reappearing in the exact same spot unaffected by events in between.

name: Timeseparation
description: Separates the subject's local timeline from the rest of the universe, causing time to flow 10 times faster for the subject while frozen to outside observers.

name: Rapid Journey
description: Allows overland travel through spatial folding at 10 times normal overland speed without fatigue or terrain obstacles.

name: Trace Gate
description: Reveals where a recently closed or active gate leads, including coordinates, dimension name, and safety hazards on arrival.

name: Diverge
description: Splits the caster into two parallel temporal versions of themselves for the duration, allowing simultaneous actions in two separate locations before merging back together.

name: Lend Energy
description: Transfers Fatigue Points (FP) directly from the caster to the subject on a 1-for-1 basis (up to 10 FP per casting). Cannot raise the subject's FP above their normal maximum.

name: Lend Vitality
description: Restores 1 to 5 lost Hit Points (HP) to a wounded subject. Costs 1 energy per HP healed. Alternatively, gives a healthy subject up to 5 extra HP for 1 hour.

name: Minor Healing
description: Restores 1 to 3 lost Hit Points to a wounded subject. Repeat castings on the same subject on the same day carry a cumulative -2 penalty per attempt (-2 for 2nd casting, -4 for 3rd, etc.).

name: Major Healing
description: Restores 2 HP per energy spent (max 8 HP restored for 4 energy). Repeat castings on the same subject on the same day suffer a cumulative -2 penalty.

name: Great Healing
description: Completely restores all lost HP to full capacity and cures all crippling injuries on a living subject. Limit of 1 attempt per day per subject by any caster.

name: Recover Energy
description: Passive spell that increases the caster's natural FP recovery rate while resting (1 FP every 5 mins at skill 15-19, 1 FP every 2 mins at skill 20+).

name: Awaken
description: Renders subjects awake and alert, countering mental or physical stunning. Sleeping or unconscious subjects roll HT (plus caster's margin of success) to awaken (-3 if injured, -6 if drugged or poisoned).

name: Cure Disease
description: Cures one specific disease or infection in the subject. Requires a Quick Contest of skill vs the disease's HT/severity rating. Does not restore lost HP caused by the disease.

name: Neutralize Poison
description: Neutralizes one poison or venom currently active in the subject's body, instantly ending its ongoing damage and effects. Does not heal damage already taken.

name: Relieve Sickness
description: Temporarily suspends all symptoms and penalties from disease, nausea, or motion sickness for 1 hour. Does not cure the underlying illness.

name: Relieve Paralysis
description: Temporarily removes physical or magical paralysis from the subject, allowing normal movement for the duration.

name: Relieve Madness
description: Temporarily suppresses insanity, phobias, hallucinations, or mental confusion in the subject for 1 hour.

name: Restoration
prerequisites: Magery 2, Major Healing, Regrowth or 6 Healing spells
description: Regenerates a lost or severed limb, organ, or eye over 1 hour. The newly restored body part functions fully immediately upon completion.

name: Regeneration
description: Causes the subject to rapidly heal 1 HP per second for the duration of the spell (up to 60 HP healed per minute).

name: Share Energy
description: Allows a willing subject to transfer their Fatigue Points directly to the caster or another target.

name: Share Vitality
description: Allows a willing target to donate their Hit Points directly to heal another wounded individual.

name: Suspended Animation
description: Places the subject into a deep stasis where metabolic functions, aging, disease progression, and poison activity halt completely. Subject requires no food, air, or water while in stasis.

name: Cleansing
prerequisites: Purify Air, Purify Water, Relieve Sickness
description: Completely sterilizes and purifies an area, killing all germs, bacteria, viruses, parasites, and filth. Grants +3 to medical/surgery checks in the cleaned area.

name: Body Reading
description: Reveals the subject's exact current HP, FP, internal injuries, diseases, toxins, parasites, and overall health status.

name: Stop Bleeding
description: Instantly stops all internal and external bleeding on the subject, preventing further bleeding damage.

name: Simple Illusion
description: Creates a simple visual illusion in a fixed location or on an object/person. The illusion can move within its area if the caster concentrates. It has no sound, smell, thermal signature, or tactile feel. Anyone who looks closely at the illusion is allowed a Vision roll to realize it is unreal. Touching the illusion automatically reveals it as a fake.

name: Complex Illusion
description: Creates an illusion with both visual and auditory elements. The illusion can move, speak, and produce appropriate sounds. It still lacks smell, heat, and physical substance. Observers get a Perception roll to doubt the illusion only if it acts out of character or does something illogical.

name: Perfect Illusion
description: Creates a complete illusion appealing to all senses: sight, sound, smell, taste, temperature, and touch (it offers tactile resistance, though it cannot inflict actual physical damage or bear heavy weight). Observers get no roll to doubt unless given a strong reason to suspect magic.

name: Illusion Shell
description: Creates a hollow visual illusion surrounding a subject or object, masking its true appearance with a chosen alternative (e.g., making a boulder look like a chest, or an ogre look like a statue). Moving subjects carry the shell with them.

name: Illusion Disguise
description: Alters the visual appearance of a person to look like another specific individual or creature of similar general size. Anyone familiar with the impersonated person can roll Vision-2 to spot flaws in the disguise.

name: Independence
description: Cast while casting an illusion spell. Allows the illusion to operate semi-independently according to pre-set instructions or basic behavioral routines without requiring the caster's ongoing concentration.

name: Control Illusion
description: Takes control of an illusion created by another spellcaster. Requires winning a Quick Contest of Skill against the original caster.

name: Dispel Illusion
description: Instantly cancels and dispels all illusions within the area of effect if the caster wins a Quick Contest of Skill against each illusion spell.

name: Know Illusion
description: Tells the caster instantly whether a specified object, creature, or phenomenon within line of sight is an illusion or real.

name: Phantom
description: Creates a quasi-real entity or creature. The phantom can move, make noise, and interact physically. It has ST equal to energy spent on Base radius x2, and HP equal to ST. It can deal real damage (though damage vanishes if phantom is dispelled).

name: Create Object
description: Creates a tangible, non-living physical object out of nothing. The object is completely real for the duration (can be used as tools, weapons, armor, etc.). At the end of the duration, it vanishes into nothingness.

name: Create Animal
description: Creates a temporary living, breathing animal. The animal obeys basic commands from the caster. It has full physical stats and can fight, transport items, or perform actions appropriate for its species.

name: Create Servant
description: Creates an obedient, human-shaped phantom servant capable of performing household chores, carrying luggage, serving food, and basic tasks (ST 10, DX 10, IQ 8, Move 4). Cannot fight.

name: Create Warrior
description: Creates a fully armed and armored warrior (ST 12, DX 12, IQ 10, HT 11, Weapon Skill 14, DR 4 armor) who fights fearlessly under the caster's command.

name: Duplicate
description: Creates an exact physical duplicate of any non-living object (up to 100 lbs) touched by the caster. The duplicate has all physical properties and functions identically to the original.

name: Disguise Object
description: Changes the physical appearance, texture, and apparent material of an object to make it resemble another object of similar volume.

name: Initiate
description: Subjects the target to a vivid, immersive hallucinatory vision or trial designed for spiritual initiation or psychological testing.

name: Detect Magic
description: Determines whether an object, person, or area is magical. A second casting tells whether the magic is temporary or permanent. Critical success gives a complete, detailed description of the spell, enchantment, or magical effect present.

name: Aura
description: Reveals a glowing halo around a living subject, providing insight into its personality, presence of Magery, Magic Resistance, emotions, physical/mental state, or supernatural possession. Critical success reveals hidden conditions such as lycanthropy, vampirism, or true demonic nature.

name: Seeker
description: Gives the caster a vision or direction leading toward a specific individual or manmade object they are searching for. Requires a personal item or physical description of the target. Modifiers apply for distance and familiarity.

name: Trace
description: Tracks the location of one specific subject. The caster knows the exact distance, direction, and movement of the subject relative to themselves for the duration of the spell.

name: Identify Spell
description: Reveals what spell or spells have just been cast (within the last 5 seconds) or are currently being cast on or by the target subject.

name: Analyze Magic
description: Fully identifies all magic spells, enchantments, curses, and active magical properties on a single subject, including secret, ancient, or unknown spells and their precise command words.

name: Find Direction
description: Informs the caster of true north (or magnetic north, if preferred) and their current direction of movement, even underground, inside caves, or during magical storms.

name: Tell Time
description: Tells the caster the exact local time to the second, as well as time elapsed since a specified event.

name: Measurement
description: Provides precise measurement of distance, height, volume, weight, speed, or temperature of a targeted object or area.

name: Test Skill
description: Reveals the target subject's numerical skill level in one specific skill specified by the caster, or reveals their single highest skill.

name: Recall
description: Allows the caster or subject to perfectly recall one specific piece of forgotten memory, text read in the past, or sensory detail experienced previously in life.

name: History
description: Gives a vision of the history of a specific object or place up to 100 years into the past, detailing significant events, owners, or occurrences associated with it.

name: Ancient History
description: Extends the historical vision capability up to 1,000 years into the past for a targeted object, ruin, or location.

name: Prehistory
description: Reveals the ancient prehistory of an object, geological formation, or region beyond 1,000 years into the distant past.

name: Images of the Past
description: Projects a visual holographic phantom in the area showing past events that occurred in that exact physical spot at a specified point in time.

name: Days of Paladin
prerequisites: Images of the Past, Ancient History
description: Projects fully audible and visual sensory re-creations of historical events from centuries past in an area.

name: See Invisible
description: Allows the subject to see naturally or magically invisible beings, objects, spirits, and force fields as if they were fully solid and visible.

name: Glass Wall
prerequisites: See Invisible, Shape Earth or Shape Material
description: Makes an opaque barrier (stone wall, wooden door, soil) completely transparent to the caster, allowing them to look directly through it as if it were clear glass.

name: Wizard Eye
description: Creates an invisible magical eye floating in midair that moves under the caster's control at Move 5, relaying full visual information back to the caster's mind.

name: Wizard Ear
prerequisites: Apportation, Sound spell or Knowledge spell
description: Creates an invisible floating magical ear that moves at Move 5 under the caster's command, relaying all audio and sounds in its location back to the caster.

name: Small Vision
description: Grants microscopic vision to the subject, allowing them to see tiny details, microscopic organisms, inscriptions, or fine flaws invisible to the naked eye.

name: Far-Seeing
description: Grants telescopic vision to the subject, magnifying distant objects and places up to several miles away without loss of clarity.

name: Divination
description: Foretells future events or answers cryptic questions about fate and destiny using a specific medium (astrology, tarot, runes, tea leaves, augury). Caster asks one specific question. Repeat castings on the same topic give unreliable results.

name: Know Location
