description: Tells the caster their exact geographical location (coordinates, nation, region, landmark name, or elevation), even when lost in planar voids or subterranean tunnels.

name: Know True Name
description: Reveals the true metaphysical secret name of a person, demon, spirit, or magical entity upon winning a Quick Contest against the subject's Will.

name: Remember Path
description: Allows the subject to perfectly trace back every step of their journey through dungeons, mazes, or wilderness without getting lost.

name: Pathfinder
description: Indicates the safest, fastest, or most direct path to a chosen destination or exit out of a complex maze or wilderness terrain.

name: Light
description: Creates a small, floating orb of light (like a candle flame) that illuminates a 2-yard radius. The caster can move the light at Move 5 with concentration. It can be cast on an object (e.g., staff or coin) to make it glow.

name: Continual Light
description: Makes an object up to 1 lb. glow continuously without requiring concentration or energy maintenance. The brightness depends on energy spent: 2 for dim moonlight, 4 for bright torchlight, 6 for brilliant daylight glare (causes -1 to attack rolls facing it). Does not count as a spell 'on'.

name: Darkness
description: Fills an area with pitch darkness. Those inside can see out normally, but outsiders cannot see into the area. Vision-based attacks into or through the dark area suffer a -10 penalty.

name: Blur
description: Makes the subject's outline blurry and indistinct. Attacking the subject suffers a penalty equal to the energy spent on the spell (-1 per point, maximum -5). Works against vision and ranged attacks.

name: Glow
description: Causes the subject (person or object) to emit soft light in a radius of 2 yards per point of energy spent (up to 6 yards). Useful as hands-free lighting or to illuminate stealthy targets.

name: Flash
description: Produces a blinding flash of light. Anyone within or looking at the area must make a HT roll (with penalties for proximity) or be blinded for 1d seconds and dazzled (-2 to all vision rolls and attack rolls) for 1d minutes.

name: Colors
description: Changes the color or pattern of an object, garment, or surface. Can be used for camouflage (+1 to +3 Stealth depending on environment) or decorative customization.

name: Small Vision
description: Magnifies microscopic or very small details for the subject. Each point of energy spent multiplies visual magnification (10x for 1 FP, 100x for 2 FP, 1,000x for 3 FP). Gives bonuses to inspection, forgery, and fine crafting.

name: Night Vision
description: Gives the subject Night Vision advantage (eliminates up to -9 in darkness penalties, provided there is at least a faint trace of ambient light). Does not function in total magical darkness.

name: Infravision
description: Allows the subject to see heat signatures (Infravision advantage). Reduces darkness penalties by up to -9 against living creatures or heat sources, and tracks warm footprints.

name: Dark Vision
description: Allows complete vision in total darkness (both natural and magical darkness) with zero penalties, seeing in full monochrome detail.

name: See Invisible
description: Allows the subject to see invisible creatures, objects, spirits, and spells as if they were fully solid and visible.

name: Shadow
description: Dims the ambient light in an area down to deep gloom/shadow. Gives a -3 penalty to all vision rolls and weapon attacks within or into the area, and +3 to Stealth rolls.

name: Blackout
description: Fills an area with pitch blackness that blocks vision completely inside and from the outside. Unlike Darkness, even those inside cannot see out without Dark Vision.

name: Shape Light
description: Bends, focuses, or redirects light rays within a area. Can focus light into beams, bend light around corners, or alter lighting focus.

name: Sunbolt
description: Hurls a beam of focused concentrated sunlight that deals 1d burning damage per energy point (max 3d). Undead and creatures vulnerable to sunlight suffer double damage or special extra effects. Range 1/2D 50, Max 100, Acc 3.

name: Sunlight
description: Creates genuine natural sunlight in the area of effect, illuminating the area as if under full noon sun. Harms light-vulnerable monsters and vampires.

name: Dispel Darkness
description: Instantly cancels and dispels any magical darkness, shadow, or blackout spells in the area of effect.

name: Invisibility
description: Renders the subject and carried equipment completely invisible to vision and light-based detection. Attacking an invisible subject carries a -10 penalty (-6 if position is known by sound/smell). Invisibility breaks if subject attacks.

name: Mirror
description: Turns any smooth flat surface (water, stone, shield, wall) into a perfect reflective mirror.

name: Body of Light
description: Transforms the caster's body and gear into a entity of pure living light. Immune to physical attacks and weapons, moves at Move 20, emits bright daylight, and can pass through transparent barriers.

name: Light Jet
description: Shoots a continuous narrow beam of dazzling laser-like light from the caster's hand. Range equal to 10 yards per point of energy spent. Requires a DX roll to hit; blinds target if hit in the eyes.

name: Radiance
description: Causes the subject to emit brilliant golden light in a 10-yard radius. Evil or undead entities within the light suffer a -2 penalty to attack rolls and ST.

name: Continual Flash
description: Produces a rapid, strobing series of intense blinding flashes in the area. Targets inside suffer continuous disorientation (-3 to DX and skill rolls, HT roll each turn to avoid blindness).

name: Find
prerequisites: Magery 1 and 2 Making & Breaking spells or 2 Knowledge spells
description: Tells the caster whether a specified type or class of object is within 10 yards. On a success, the direction to the nearest such object is revealed. If no object of that kind is within range, the spell fails.

name: Simple Repair
initialCost: 2 for an object up to 1 lb.; 5 for an object up to 5 lbs.
description: Fixes a small broken object weighing up to 5 lbs. The pieces must all be present and held together while casting. The object becomes as good as new. Does not work on complex machinery with many moving parts or magical items.

name: Shatter
description: Instantly shatters or breaks a rigid, non-living object (glass, stone, wood, metal). If cast on a target held or worn by someone, or if the item is magical, it resists using HT or item DR. Against crystalline or inanimate constructs, inflicts 1d crushing damage per energy spent, ignoring armor.

name: Soften
description: Makes hard, non-metallic solid materials (wood, stone, bone, plastic) soft, pliable, and flexible like putty or rubber without altering their weight or overall appearance. Softened weapons cannot inflict cutting or impaling damage.

name: Stiffen
description: Makes flexible, non-metallic materials (cloth, leather, rope, paper) completely rigid and stiff like hard wood or stone. Flexible armor subjected to this spell counts as rigid armor with +1 DR but penalizes DX.

name: Clean
initialCost: 1 per 10 lbs. of object or 1 per yard radius of area
description: Instantly removes all dirt, dust, grime, stains, grease, and unwanted residue from an object, garment, person, or specified area, making it spotlessly clean.

name: Soil
initialCost: 1 per 10 lbs. of object or 1 per yard radius of area
description: Covers a clean object, garment, person, or area in dirt, soot, mud, grease, and unpleasant stains as if it had been neglected or dragged through grime.

name: Dye
description: Changes the color or pattern of an object, cloth, leather, hair, or surface to any desired color or shade. The dye is permanent and will not wash off naturally.

name: Remove Dye
description: Removes all artificial dye, paint, stains, or colorings from an object, garment, or hair, restoring its underlying natural color.

name: Restore
description: Completely restores a broken, decayed, rusted, ruined, or shattered item back to factory-new pristine condition. Missing parts up to 50% of the item's mass are recreated out of ambient raw material. Does not restore destroyed magical properties.

name: Ruin
description: Causes an inanimate object to instantly age, rot, rust, corrode, and crumble into useless, decayed junk. Objects held, worn, or magical resist with HT or DR.

name: Copy
initialCost: 4 per lb. of target object weight
description: Creates an exact physical duplicate of a non-magical object out of raw material of similar composition provided during casting. The copy matches all physical traits, markings, and flaws of the original.

name: Reconstruct
description: Grants the caster a visual and mental reconstruction of what a broken, ruined, or fragmented object looked like when intact, how it functioned, and precisely how and when it was damaged or destroyed.

name: Fasten
description: Magically bonds two surfaces or objects together at the point of contact as if welded, glued, or fused into a single seamless piece. Holds against pressure up to ST 30.

name: Unfasten
description: Instantly undoes mechanical, glued, welded, nailed, riveted, or magically fastened joints between objects, separating them cleanly without damaging the underlying material.

name: Sharpen
description: Gives a razor-sharp edge or needle point to a cutting or impaling weapon, granting a +1 bonus to all cutting and impaling damage inflicted by the weapon for the duration.

name: Dull
description: Removes the sharp edge or point from a blade, arrowhead, or spearhead. Affected weapons suffer a -1 penalty to cutting/impaling damage (or convert cutting damage to crushing damage if reduced below 0).

name: Toughen
description: Increases the structural Damage Resistance (DR) of an inanimate object by +2 and grants +2 to its HT rolls against breakage or destruction.

name: Weaken
description: Reduces the structural DR of an inanimate object by -2 (minimum DR 0) and renders its material brittle, imposing -2 to all HT rolls against breakage.

name: Knot
description: Magically ties a flexible cord, rope, thread, or cable into a knot of specified complexity. Requires a DX or Knot-Tying roll with a +5 bonus to untie non-magically.

name: Untie
description: Instantly unravels and unties any non-magical knot, binding, or lashings on a rope, string, or cord within range.

name: Reshape
description: Allows the caster to re-sculpt a solid object (metal, wood, stone) with their hands like soft clay into a new permanent shape without altering its total mass or density.

name: Contract Object
description: Shrinks an inanimate object down to 1/10th of its linear dimensions and volume without altering its actual weight or mass. Useful for transporting bulky gear.

name: Extend Object
description: Expands an inanimate object up to 10 times its original linear size and length while maintaining its original mass and weight.

name: Transform Object
description: Transmutes an inanimate object made of one common substance (wood, iron, stone, glass) into an equal mass of another non-precious substance. Cannot create precious metals or gems.

name: Disintegrate
description: Completely vaporizes an inanimate object into nothingness. If cast on a living target or magical item, the target resists using HT or DR; on a failure, it suffers 2d disintegrating damage per 5 energy spent, bypassing all armor.

name: Repair
description: Fully repairs complex mechanical items, clockwork, vehicles, weapons, or machinery that are broken, dismantled, or severely damaged, restoring all mechanisms to perfect working order.

name: Abundance
description: Multiplies a quantity of non-magical raw materials, crops, timber, or crafted goods, creating identical permanent copies of the bulk material.

name: Counterspell
initialCost: Half the cost to cast the spell being countered (minimum 1)
prerequisites: Magery 1, and either the spell being countered or research into it.
description: Cancels an active ongoing spell or negates a spell while it is being cast. Counterspell must be cast at the spell itself or its subject. The caster must know what spell is being countered. To cancel an active spell, win a Quick Contest against the skill of the original caster at the time of casting. Counterspell cannot affect permanent enchantments.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Neutralizes and ends all ongoing spells within its area of effect. Dispel Magic does not prevent new spells from being cast into or within the area. For each spell in the area, roll a Quick Contest between Dispel Magic and the original spell's effective skill. Spells that lose the contest are dispelled immediately. Does not affect permanent enchantments unless specified.

name: Ward
description: Cast as an active defense against an incoming spell targeting the caster or a subject within touch range. Win a Quick Contest of skill against the incoming spell's caster to block and negate the spell entirely. Ward counts as an active defense maneuver.

name: Great Ward
description: Functions like Ward, but can protect an entire area or any subject within sight of the caster against an incoming spell. Win a Quick Contest of skill against the incoming spell's effective skill to negate it.

name: Reflect
description: Cast as an active defense against an incoming spell. If successful in a Quick Contest against the attacker's spell skill, the incoming spell is reflected back upon its caster, who suffers its full effects as if they were the original target.

name: Spell Shield
description: Creates a personal barrier around the subject that absorbs incoming spells. Any spell cast at the subject must overcome the Spell Shield by winning a Quick Contest against the Spell Shield skill. If the spell loses, it fizzles harmlessly against the shield without consuming the shield.

name: Spell Wall
description: Erects a wall or dome of anti-magical force around an area. Any spell passing through or cast into/out of the area must win a Quick Contest against the Spell Wall skill or be completely blocked and negated.

name: Scryguard
description: Protects a subject, object, or location from Information spells, scrying, and magical detection (such as Seeker, Mind-Reading, Wizard Eye, or Divination). Anyone attempting to scry the protected subject must win a Quick Contest against the Scryguard skill to see or learn anything.

name: Scrywall
description: Encloses an area in a barrier against all scrying and information-gathering spells. Anyone attempting to use Information spells across the barrier must win a Quick Contest against Scrywall skill.

name: Scry Fool
description: Feeds false information to anyone attempting to scry or gather information on the subject with magical means. If the scrier fails to win a Quick Contest against Scry Fool, they perceive a false vision or result predetermined by the caster.

name: False Aura
description: Alters the magical aura of a person or item as perceived by Aura or Detect Magic spells. The caster can make a magical item appear mundane, a non-magical person appear to have Magery, or disguise alignment/emotions.

name: Conceal Magic
description: Hides the presence of magic in an item or person. Detect Magic and similar spells will fail to detect any magical energy unless the scrier wins a Quick Contest against Conceal Magic.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Grants the subject temporary Magic Resistance advantage, giving +1 per 2 energy spent to all resistance rolls against spells and imposing an equal penalty on any spells cast at or by the subject.

name: Suspend Magic
description: Temporarily suppresses all magic and active spells within the area of effect for the duration of the spell. Spells suspended resume their normal duration when Suspend Magic ends.

name: Drain Mana
description: Permanently reduces the local mana level in an area by one step (e.g., Very High to High, High to Normal, Normal to Low, or Low to No Mana). Creating a No Mana zone prevents all spellcasting within the area.

name: Restore Mana
description: Increases the local mana level in an area by one step (e.g., Low to Normal, Normal to High). Can restore mana to an area affected by Drain Mana.

name: Steal Energy
description: Drains Fatigue Points from a living target touched by the caster and transfers them directly to the caster's own FP pool. Target resists with HT.

name: Steal Mana
description: Temporarily steals Magery levels from a spellcaster touched by the user upon winning a Quick Contest of skill vs Will, reducing target's Magery while increasing caster's Magery by equal amount.

name: Throw Spell
description: Allows the caster to deliver a Touch or Melee spell at range by throwing the spell energy as a missile attack at a distant target.

name: Catch Spell
description: Intersects an incoming Missile spell targeted at the caster. Upon a successful roll, the caster catches the spell in hand without taking damage and can hurl it back on their next turn.

name: Maintain Spell
initialCost: Equal to original spell's maintenance cost + 1
description: Sustains an ongoing active spell cast by another caster or by oneself without requiring continuous concentration or counting against the limit of spells 'on'.

name: Suspend Spell
initialCost: Half the cost of target spell (min 2)
description: Puts an ongoing spell into temporary stasis for 1 hour. While suspended, the spell has no effect and consumes no maintenance, but resumes when Suspend Spell ends.

name: Dispel Possession
description: Exorcises an entity, spirit, or spellcaster possessing a subject's body. Caster must win a Quick Contest of skill against possessor's Will to eject the spirit.

name: Bless
description: Bestows divine or magical good fortune upon the subject. Grants die roll re-rolls or situational bonuses that trigger automatically when the subject faces danger or adversity.

name: Curse
description: Afflicts the subject with bad luck and misfortune. Causes critical failures or catastrophic bad luck during critical moments until removed by Remove Curse.

name: Remove Curse
description: Lifts a Curse or evil affliction from a subject or item upon winning a Quick Contest against the original Curse skill.

name: Pentagram
description: Draws a protective pentagram star diagram on the floor that prevents supernatural beings, spirits, demons, and hostile spells from crossing the line.

name: Exchange Spells
description: Swaps known spell lists or specific active spells between two spellcasters for the duration upon winning a Quick Contest.

name: Mage Sense
description: Alerts the caster to the presence of any active spellcasting or magical energy being drawn within a 10-yard radius.

name: Mage Sight
description: Allows the subject to visually see magical energy fields, active spells, magical items, and invisible magic lines glowing brightly.

name: Continual Mage Sight
description: Grants Mage Sight for an extended duration of 1 hour without requiring continuous active concentration.

name: Foolishness
description: Reduces the subject's IQ, and all IQ-based skills (including spellcasting skill), by 1 per point of energy spent (maximum 5). Does not affect perception or Will.

name: Daze
description: Renders the subject stunned and unable to take actions. The subject stands stupified and unaware until struck or shaken awake.

name: Mass Daze
description: Casts Daze over an entire area, stupifying all living targets inside who fail their HT resistance roll.

name: Sleep
description: Causes subject to fall into deep natural sleep for 8 hours. If woken by loud noise or injury, subject is mentally stunned.

name: Mass Sleep
description: Casts Sleep over an entire area, causing all targets inside who fail HT roll to fall into deep sleep for 8 hours.

name: Peaceful Sleep
description: Ensures the subject sleeps peacefully for up to 8 hours without nightmares, waking up fully rested and cured of insomnia or fatigue penalty from bad sleep.

name: Mental Stun
description: Mentally stuns the subject immediately upon failing a Will resistance roll. Subject must roll IQ-1 each turn to recover from stun.

name: Command
description: Gives the subject a 1- or 2-word command (e.g., 'Drop it!', 'Look!', 'Wait!', 'Halt!') which must be obeyed immediately on their next turn.

name: Forgetfulness
description: Causes subject to temporarily forget one specific fact, skill, or spell for 1 hour. Forgotten skills or spells cannot be used while affected.

name: Permanent Forgetfulness
description: Permanently erases one specific memory, skill, or spell from the subject's mind unless restored by high-level magic.

name: Drunkenness
description: Simulates acute alcohol intoxication. Each level imposes a -2 penalty to DX, IQ, and all DX/IQ-based skills and active defenses.

name: Charm
description: Makes the subject regard the caster as a trusted, dear friend. Subject will obey reasonable requests, but won't do obviously self-destructive acts.

name: Enslave
prerequisites: Magery 3, Charm, 5 other Mind Control spells
description: Places the subject under permanent, total mental domination by the caster. The subject obeys every command without hesitation.

name: Suggestion
description: Plants a plausible suggestion or course of action in the subject's mind that seems like their own idea. Must sound reasonable to the subject.

name: Mass Suggestion
description: Plants a plausible suggestion into the minds of everyone in an entire area who fails their Will resistance roll.

name: Loyalty
description: Makes the subject intensely loyal to a specific person, leader, or cause designated by the caster.

name: Disloyalty
description: Breaks or turns the subject's existing loyalty, causing them to doubt, distrust, or betray their current master or cause.

name: Rearrange Loyalty
description: Allows caster to swap or modify the subject's allegiances, making friends seem like enemies and enemies seem like allies.

name: Bravery
description: Renders the subject immune to fear, morale checks, Fright Checks, and intimidate attempts for the duration.

name: Fear
description: Instills a sense of overwhelming dread in the subject, imposing a -2 penalty on all rolls and requiring Fright Check if confronted.

name: Panic
description: Creates a sphere of irrational terror. Subjects in the area who fail Will resistance roll immediately flee in panic.

name: Terror
description: Forces the target to make an immediate Fright Check at a penalty equal to the caster's margin of victory in casting.

name: Gloom
description: Fills an area with deep depression and apathy. Subjects in the area suffer -2 to Will, morale, and reaction rolls.

name: Fascination
description: Causes the subject to become totally captivated by a designated object or person, ignoring everything else until disturbed.

name: Disorient
description: Confuses subject's sense of direction and balance, giving -2 to DX, Move, and orientation rolls.

name: Madness
description: Induces temporary insanity or severe mental illness in the subject (paranoia, hallucinations, or hysteria).

name: Hallucination
description: Causes the subject to perceive vivid false sensory visions and sounds that exist only in their own mind.

name: Mass Hallucination
description: Creates shared mental hallucinations among all targets in an entire area who fail Will resistance roll.

name: Nightmare
description: Inflicts terrifying nightmares on a sleeping subject, preventing natural FP recovery and causing 1d damage from exhaustion/fright.

name: Brainwash
description: Systematically rewrites the subject's beliefs, personality traits, disadvantages, and loyalty through intensive mental conditioning.

name: Lesser Geas
description: Compels subject to fulfill a specific quest or obligation. If subject strays from quest, they suffer cumulative penalties to HT and attributes.

name: Great Geas
description: Binds subject to a major quest under penalty of severe wasting disease and death if ignored or abandoned.

name: Telecontrol
description: Takes direct telepathic remote control of subject's body while caster remains conscious and aware of surroundings.

name: Memory Loop
description: Traps the subject in a repeating 5-second loop of thought or action, preventing them from reacting to new events.

name: Apportation
initialCost: Varies (1 for <1 lb, 2 for <=10 lbs, 3 for <=50 lbs, 4 for <=200 lbs, +4 per 100 lbs)
description: Levitates and moves physical objects without touching them at Move 1. Living subjects resist with Will. Cannot move objects fast enough to do damage or parry weapons.

name: Deflect Missile
description: Deflects one incoming physical missile attack (arrow, thrown rock, bullet) safely away from the subject. Counts as an active defense (parry) against missile attacks.

name: Haste
description: Increases the subject's Basic Move and Dodge scores by +1 to +3 for 1 minute. Increases top running speed and combat movement proportionally.

name: Great Haste
description: Grants subject 1 level of Altered Time Rate (doubles available maneuvers and actions each turn) for 10 seconds. Costs subject 5 FP when the spell ends due to extreme physical strain.

name: Slow
description: Reduces subject's Move and Dodge scores by 1 to 3 points (minimum Move 1). Target feels lethargic and slow.

name: Poltergeist
description: Hurls small loose objects in the area at a target. Deals 1d-3 damage per lb of object (max Move 10, Acc 1, Range 10). Target may Dodge.

name: Levitate
description: Lifts a subject straight up into the air at Move 1 (up to 100 yards high). Subject cannot move horizontally except by pushing off fixed structures or pulling ropes.

name: Fly
description: Allows subject to fly through the air in any direction at Move equal to double the caster's spell skill (max Move 20). Requires concentration to steer smoothly.

name: Hawk Flight
description: Allows subject to fly at tremendous speed (Move equal to 5x spell skill, up to Move 100). Maneuverability is limited at top speed.

name: Light Step
description: Subject steps so lightly that they leave no footprints, trigger no pressure plates or tripwires, and make zero footsteps noise (+5 to Stealth checks).

name: Jump
description: Instantly propels subject in a single leaping bound up to energy spent * 3 yards horizontally or energy spent * 1.5 yards vertically without taking falling damage upon landing.

name: Great Jump
description: Multiplies subject's normal jumping distance by energy spent (e.g. 4 energy = 2x jump distance). Safe landing included.

name: Swim
description: Propels subject through water effortlessly at Move equal to normal Swimming skill without expending physical stamina.

name: Walk on Water
description: Allows subject to stand and walk on the surface of liquid (water, oil, mud) as if it were solid ground. High waves impose balance checks.

name: Wallwalker
description: Allows subject to walk up vertical walls and across ceilings at normal Move speed as if gravity were reoriented toward the surface.

name: Slow Fall
description: Instantly reduces falling speed of subject to a gentle feather-like descent (Move 2 down), completely preventing all falling impact damage.

name: Flight
description: Grants natural winged or wingless Flight advantage with Move equal to double Basic Speed. Subject moves effortlessly without concentration.

name: Ethereal Body
description: Renders subject and carried equipment completely intangible (Insubstantial). Subject can walk through walls and solid matter, immune to physical attacks except magic/ghostly weapons.

name: Lockmaster
description: Telekinetically manipulates internal pins and tumblers inside a mechanical lock to pick and open it instantly. Roll spell skill vs lock difficulty.

name: Locklick
description: Unlocks any standard non-magical latch or simple bolt lock instantly with a quiet click.

name: Undo
description: Unties knots, unbuckles straps, opens latches, and undoes simple fasteners automatically across clothing, armor, or ropes.

name: Magnet
description: Draws metal objects toward subject's hand like a powerful magnet. Can disarm metallic weapons on a won Quick Contest vs target's ST.

name: Pull
description: Yanks a target object or person directly toward the caster at high speed. Unprepared target must roll ST to avoid stumbling or falling prone.

name: Repel
description: Pushes a target object or person forcefully away from the caster. Target must roll ST-2 or be knocked backward and fall prone.

name: Winged Knife
description: Hurls a thrown blade, dagger, or missile weapon with magical force. Deals weapon's basic thrust+1 damage + 1d per energy spent. Range 1/2D 20, Max 40.

name: Flying Fists
description: Allows caster to strike enemies at range (up to 10 yards away) with invisible telekinetic punches using normal Brawling or Karate skill.

name: Manipulate
description: Allows fine telekinetic manipulation at a distance (writing, turning keys, tying knots, untying laces) using caster's DX.

name: Distant Blow
description: Delivers a melee weapon strike or unarmed punch at range (up to 10 yards away) through telekinetic force.

name: Turn Blade
description: Telekinetically nudges an incoming melee weapon strike slightly off course, imposing a -2 penalty to attacker's hit roll or deflecting a critical hit.

name: Death Vision
description: Shows the subject a terrifying illusion of their own future death. Target must make an immediate Fright Check at -2. On a critical failure, the subject collapses in terror or suffers a heart attack depending on the Fright Check table.

name: Sense Spirit
description: Tells the caster whether any spirits (ghosts, demons, astral entities, undead spirits) are present in the area, giving their general nature, type, and location.

name: Summon Spirit
description: Calls forth the spirit of a deceased person to answer questions. The spirit is compelled to answer truthfully if it fails its resistance roll (Will). The spirit knows only what it knew in life.

name: Animation
description: Animates an inanimate object (or an un-living skeleton/corpse without raising it as true undead), making it move according to the caster's simple physical commands.

name: Zombie
description: Animates a dead human or animal corpse into a permanently obedient undead zombie or skeleton servant that follows the caster's simple verbal or mental commands.

name: Mass Zombie
description: Animates all corpses or skeletons within an area of effect into obedient undead servants at a reduced per-subject energy cost.

name: Control Zombie
class: Regular [Resisted by Zombie's Will or Caster's skill]
description: Takes control of an undead zombie or skeleton created by another spellcaster upon winning a Quick Contest of Skill vs subject's resistance.

name: Turn Zombie
description: Drives away all animated zombies and skeletons within the area of effect. Affected undead flee from the caster and cannot enter the area for 1 day.

name: Banish
description: Sends an extradimensional entity, demon, spirit, or summoned creature back to its home plane upon winning a Quick Contest of skill vs entity's Will.

name: Skull-Spirit
description: Inscribes runes on a human skull, trapping a fiery vengeful spirit within. When triggered by proximity or intrusion, the skull flies forth at Move 10 and attacks the target until destroyed or defeated.

name: Soul Jar
description: Transfers a dying or living subject's soul into a specially prepared container (gem, bottle, jar). The body dies, but the soul remains alive and conscious inside the jar indefinitely.

name: Steal Vitality
prerequisites: Lend Vitality, Vampiric Touch or Minor Healing
description: Drains Hit Points from a touched living target and transfers them directly to the caster, healing the caster's wounds on a 1-for-1 basis.

name: Steal Youth
description: Drains physical age from a victim, making the target older while reducing the caster's apparent and physical age. Target ages prematurely by 1 year per 10 energy spent.

name: Permanent Steal Youth
description: Permanently drains years of youth from a human victim during an elaborate ritual, transferring those years to the caster permanently.

name: Corpse-Eater
description: Consumes a fresh corpse to restore caster's lost HP and Fatigue Points, absorbing the deceased's biological energy completely.

name: Materialize
description: Grants a spirit or ghost a temporary physical body, allowing it to interact physically with the real world, touch objects, and be affected by physical attacks.

name: Affect Spirits
description: Allows the subject's physical attacks, weapons, and spells to strike and harm immaterial spirits, ghosts, and astral beings normally.

name: Astral Vision
description: Allows the caster to see into the spirit world and astral plane, perceiving ghosts, spirits, and invisible ethereal entities in their true form.

name: Solidify
description: Forces an intangible spirit, ghost, or ethereal creature into a semi-tangible physical state, making it vulnerable to normal physical weapons.

name: Spirit Warning
description: Attunes the caster to spirit activity, alerting them instantly if any ghost, spirit, or supernatural entity approaches within 30 yards.

name: Summon Demon
description: Summons a malevolent demon from the nether realms. The caster must win a Contest of Skill vs Demon's Will to command it; failure causes the demon to attack or backfire on the summoner.

name: Control Demon
description: Gains temporary mental control over a summoned or encountered demon upon winning a Quick Contest of Skill vs Demon's Will.

name: Command Spirit
description: Compels a ghost, spirit, or astral entity to obey the caster's commands for the duration upon winning a Quick Contest of Skill vs Will.

name: Entrap Spirit
description: Binds a target spirit or ghost inside an object (bottle, ring, amulet, stone), trapping it permanently until the container is shattered or unsealed.

name: Repel Spirit
description: Creates a protective barrier around an area that prevents ghosts, spirits, and astral entities from entering unless they win a Quick Contest vs spell skill.

name: Rotting Touch
description: Inflicts rotting necrotic damage (1d toxic/corrosive damage per energy point spent) to a target touched in melee, causing flesh to decay and blacken.

name: Pestilence
description: Infects all living creatures in the area with a virulent contagion or disease unless they succeed on a HT resistance roll.

name: Steal Beauty
description: Drains physical beauty from a target and transfers it to the caster, increasing the caster's Appearance level while reducing the victim's by an equal amount.

name: Age
description: Prematurely ages a target by 1 year per 5 energy spent, forcing immediate aging rolls if the target passes critical age thresholds.

name: Lich
prerequisites: Magery 3, Soul Jar, Zombie, Steal Youth
description: A dark ritual that transforms the caster into an immortal undead Lich, retaining all mental capabilities, spellcasting skills, and Magery while becoming immune to metabolic hazards, aging, and poison.

name: Seek Plant
description: Points in the direction and gives distance to the nearest specimen of a specified plant species, or simply the nearest plant of any kind if unspecified.

name: Identify Plant
description: Identifies the species, properties (including medicinal, poisonous, or magical traits), and state of health of one targeted plant.

name: Heal Plant
description: Cures disease, blight, infestation, or physical damage in a plant. Restores HP equal to energy spent.

name: Plant Growth
description: Accelerates the natural growth of a plant or group of plants. One minute of spellcasting accomplishes a month of growth.

name: Bless Plants
description: Ensures healthy growth and high crop yield over an entire field or forest area for one full growing season, granting protection against ordinary blights and pests.

name: Plant Speech
description: Allows the caster to communicate verbally with plants. Plants have primitive senses and memories about who or what passed by recently.

name: Plant Sense
description: Allows the caster to see and hear through the flowers, leaves, or trunk of a target plant within range.

name: Plant Form
description: Transforms the caster into a living plant (bush, small tree, flower). Caster retains consciousness and mental attributes but gains natural plant traits and cannot move unless a moving plant species.

name: Plant Form Other
description: Transforms another subject into a specified living plant. Subject resists with HT.

name: Hide Path
description: Causes underbrush and branches to weave together and conceal all tracks, trails, or footprints in the area, giving -5 to tracking rolls.

name: Tangle Growth
description: Causes grasses, roots, and bushes in the area to entangle anyone passing through, reducing Move score to 1 and requiring ST or DX rolls to move.

name: Walk Through Plants
description: Allows the subject to walk through dense foliage, thorny briars, and thick forests effortlessly without noise, slowdown, or damage.

name: Plant Vision
description: Allows the subject to see through trees, leaves, and wooden structures up to 50 yards deep as if they were transparent glass.

name: Shape Plant
duration: 1 min. (permanent if shaped into stable form)
description: Sculpts, bends, and moulds living or dead wood, plants, and trees into desired shapes (bridges, ladders, fences, weapons).

name: Wither Plant
description: Causes a plant or wooden object to wither, decay, or die. Deals 1d damage to plant creatures or wood per energy spent.

name: Forest Warning
description: Enchants a woodland area to mentally alert the caster whenever an intruder enters the forest bounds.

name: Rejuvenate Plant
description: Restores a dead or withered plant back to full vibrant life, provided its roots or seeds are intact.

name: Blossom
description: Causes a plant, bush, or tree to immediately bloom with flowers or bear ripe fruit ahead of season.

name: Pollen
description: Creates a thick cloud of irritating or allergenic pollen in the area, causing subjects inside to sneeze, cough, and suffer -3 to DX and Perception rolls.

name: Essential Wood
description: Creates or transforms wood into Magical Essential Wood, which has double the DR and HP of normal wood and is immune to non-magical rot and fire.

name: Wood Wall
description: Conjures a sturdy wall of dense wood and thorny vines (DR 4, HP 30 per yard of width) to block paths or provide cover.

name: Animate Plant
description: Animates a tree, bush, or vine, giving it locomotion and the ability to fight or carry out physical tasks commanded by the caster.

name: Create Plant
description: Creates healthy, living vegetation of any chosen species out of nothingness.

name: Body of Wood
description: Transforms the caster's body into living wood. Grants DR 3, ST +4, vulnerability to fire, and immunity to bleeding and poison.

name: Plant Control
description: Controls the mind and actions of a plant creature or animated plant upon winning a Quick Contest of Skill vs Will.

name: Blight
description: Infests crops, trees, and gardens across an entire area with devastating disease, rot, and pestilence.

name: False Tracks
description: Manipulates plants and grass to form misleading animal or human tracks leading in directions chosen by the caster.

name: Arbor Sense
description: Allows the caster to sense the exact location, condition, and presence of all trees and major plant life within a 1-mile radius.

name: Sense Observation
description: Tells the caster whether he is currently being observed by any intelligent being, either directly or via magical means (e.g., Wizard Eye, Scrying, or Clairvoyance). If successful, tells the caster the direction of the observer and whether the observation is direct or via magical sensor.

name: Sense Danger
description: Warns the caster if any immediate physical danger threatens him, his companions, or his current location within 10 yards, occurring within the next 5 minutes. Gives a general impression of the nature and severity of the danger (e.g., ambush, trap, collapse, poison).

name: Watchdog
description: Wards an area. If any unauthorized, hostile, or unauthorized intelligent creature enters the warded area while Watchdog is active, the spell instantly alerts the caster mentally (awakening him if asleep) and specifies where the breach occurred.

name: Alarm
description: Creates an audible or visible alarm (bell chime, horn blast, red flash) when any unauthorized subject steps into the warded area or opens a warded door/window. Caster specifies triggering conditions upon casting.

name: Nightingale
description: Creates an area warded with gentle acoustic warnings. When any unauthorized creature enters, soft musical notes or birdsong alert the caster without alerting the intruder.

name: Tell Tale
description: Placed upon a container, door, lock, or secret compartment. If the object is opened or tampered with by anyone other than the caster, a subtle mark or change occurs that only the caster will notice upon return (or alerts the caster mentally if nearby).

name: Shield
description: Conjures an invisible shield of force in front of the subject. Gives a +1 to +4 Defense Bonus (DB) to all active defenses (Block, Dodge, Parry) against attacks from the front and sides.

name: Armor
description: Grants the subject an invisible layer of magical force providing 1 to 6 points of Damage Resistance (DR). This DR protects against all physical damage and stacks with worn armor and natural DR.

name: Magelock
description: Magically seals a door, chest, gate, or window shut. To open the sealed hatch, an intruder must pick the lock with a -5 penalty, force it open winning a contest against the caster's spell skill, or use Lockmaster/Dispel Magic.

name: Missile Shield
description: Creates a force dome around the subject that completely deflects all physical missile attacks (arrows, bolts, thrown spears, bullets, rocks) away harmlessly without touching the target.

name: Reverse Missiles
description: Any physical missile attack aimed at the subject is instantly deflected directly back toward the attacker, using the attacker's original roll to hit to resolve impact on the attacker.

name: Iron Arm
description: Allows the caster to parry any incoming weapon attack (including edged or heavy weapons like axes and broadswords) barehanded without taking injury to his arm or hand.

name: Force Dome
description: Creates an impenetrable dome of shimmering force overhead and around the area. Blocks all physical attacks, spells, energy beams, and solid objects in both directions.

name: Utter Dome
description: Creates a pitch-black force dome that blocks all matter, energy, light, sound, magic, telepathy, and dimensional travel from passing in or out. Absolutely nothing can penetrate it.

name: Weather Dome
description: Creates a protective dome over the area that keeps out natural rain, snow, hail, wind, sandstorms, and extreme temperature discomfort while allowing light and fresh air through.

name: Mystic Mark
description: Imprints an invisible magical mark or symbol onto a person, creature, or object. The mark can only be seen with See Invisible or Detect Magic, or by those designated by the caster.

name: Mind Shield
description: Erects a mental barrier giving the subject a +1 to +5 bonus on Will rolls to resist all mental attacks, telepathy, Mind Control, and Communication/Empathy spells.

name: Bladestorm
description: Surrounds the area with a swirling storm of razor-sharp force blades. Anyone attempting to pass through the barrier takes 2d cutting damage per second.

name: Force Wall
description: Conjures a flat vertical wall of impenetrable force (3 yards high by user-chosen length). Completely blocks physical movement, missiles, and energy attacks.

name: Utter Wall
description: Creates a flat vertical wall of absolute nothingness that blocks all matter, energy, light, sound, magic, telepathy, and teleportation.

name: Personal Shield
description: Conjures a personal force layer that absorbs up to 10 points of damage from energy, fire, heat, cold, or electricity attacks before dissolving.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Grants the subject 1 to 5 levels of Magic Resistance. Increases subject's resistance rolls against spells and reduces caster skill when targeting subject.

name: Sound
description: Creates any simple, realistic sound originating from any designated point within range. The sound cannot be louder than a shouting voice or a small drum beat. The caster specifies the precise acoustic nature of the sound upon casting.

name: Silence
description: Eliminates all sound within the designated area of effect. No sound can enter, leave, or be produced within the warded zone. Spells requiring spoken incantations cannot be cast within or into the area unless spoken silently/telepathically.

name: Quiet
description: Reduces the volume of all sounds originating within or passing through the area. Gives a +2 bonus to Stealth rolls for anyone moving inside the area and a -2 penalty to Hearing rolls for anyone attempting to listen to sounds generated inside.

name: Wall of Silence
description: Creates an invisible vertical curtain or perimeter of absolute silence along the boundary of the area. Sound cannot cross the barrier in either direction, though sounds produced inside or outside propagate normally on their respective sides.

name: Mass Silence
description: Silences a large area or group of subjects specified by the caster. Affected targets cannot produce any vocal sounds, walk without making footstep noises, or recite spoken spell incantations while inside.

name: Thunderclap
description: Produces a sudden, deafening crack of thunder at any designated point within range. Everyone within 5 yards must roll vs. HT or be stunned for 1d seconds and deafened for 1d minutes. Critical failure causes permanent hearing damage unless healed magically.

name: Garble
description: Distorts and scrambles spoken words originating from the target. The target's speech sounds like meaningless gibberish to all listeners, preventing verbal communication and making spoken spellcasting completely impossible.

name: Voices
description: Creates multiple distinct spoken voices or murmurs within the area of effect. The voices can carry on believable conversations, whispers, or shouts as determined by the caster upon casting.

name: Far-Hearing
description: Allows the caster to hear acoustic signals from a distant location as if standing at that spot. The caster chooses a focal point within range and hears all ambient sounds clearly.

name: Keen Hearing
description: Gives the target +1 to Hearing rolls per point of energy invested (maximum +5). Allows hearing faint whispers, subtle footsteps, and distant acoustic details with extreme clarity.

name: Imitate Sound
description: Allows the caster or target to perfectly mimic any sound, voice tone, or musical cadence previously heard. Grants a +4 bonus to Disguise or Acting rolls involving vocal mimicry.

name: Great Voice
description: Amplifies the subject's spoken voice to thunderous volume without distortion or straining vocal cords. The voice can be heard clearly up to 1 mile away in open air, or across noisy battlefields.

name: Sound Jet
description: Shoots a concentrated beam of focused acoustic energy from the caster's hand. Inflicts 1d crushing damage per point of energy spent (maximum 3d) to a target in a straight line up to 10 yards away. Target must roll vs. HT or be knocked down.

name: Musical Scribe
description: Automatically transcribes any music, melody, or speech heard by the caster directly onto blank parchment or paper in clear, precise musical notation or written text.

name: Noise
description: Fills the area with a loud, distracting din (clattering, buzzing, grinding, shouting). Imposes a -2 penalty to IQ, Concentration, and Hearing rolls for anyone inside the area.

name: Conversationalist
description: Creates an invisible phantom speaker that engages nearby individuals in believable, polite conversation on general topics, distracting guards, sentries, or bystanders for the duration of the spell.

name: Subdue Sound
description: Dampens all high-intensity noises in the area to a comfortable whisper. Protects those inside from sonic attacks, thunderclaps, and flashbangs, granting a +4 bonus on rolls to resist acoustic damage or deafening.

name: Echoes
description: Causes all sounds generated in the area to echo continuously, overlapping and multiplying into disorienting acoustic reverberations. Imposes a -3 penalty to Hearing rolls and -1 to attack rolls for targets inside.

name: Sound Vision
description: Grants the target echolocation (sonar vision), allowing them to perceive their physical surroundings in total darkness by sensing reflected acoustic waves. Ignores all darkness vision penalties.

name: Resonance
description: Vibrates a target solid non-magical object or structure at its natural resonant frequency, causing severe internal stress. Deals 1d crushing damage per energy spent, completely bypassing the DR of rigid materials like stone, glass, or metal.

name: Disrupt
description: Focuses highly destructive acoustic vibrations directly into a living subject or solid object, causing intense internal tearing and structural shattering. Inflicts 3d+3 crushing armor-piercing damage.

name: Seek Machine/TL
description: Identifies the direction and approximate distance of the nearest machinery of any sort. The caster can also specify that he is looking for a specific sort of device; lasers, computers, light sources, etc. Any known examples of technology may be excluded if the mage specifies them before casting. Use long-distance modifiers.

name: Reveal Function/TL
class: Information; Resisted by spells to conceal magic
description: Reveals the functions of the subject machine. If the subject has more than one function, the spell reveals them in order of complexity (simplest first), and tells the caster 'there are more functions.' Later castings will reveal the remaining functions, one per casting. The spell can also be used to reveal how to activate known functions (i.e., which button to press); the caster gets one try, at -5! If successful, the caster can then use the machine with the appropriate skill (or IQ-6) at a penalty of only -1 for unfamiliarity.

name: Machine Control/TL
description: Control the actions of one machine (anything under IQ 6, of any size) or a swarm of small ones, up to about 1,000 machines or 100 pounds total. The caster must be aware of the machine's functions to control it. The spell does not supply the skill to use the machine – the caster must use his own skill at Gunner, Computer Operation, Driving, and so on. Concentration is required. The spell acts through the machine's triggers and controls, mechanical or electrical. A mage could use the spell to make a camera snap a picture, a robot strangle its evil creator, or a gun discharge all of its ammunition. He could not aim the object, or move it, unless it was self-aiming or self-propelled (at least without adding an Apportation spell). If something else has control (an AI in a vehicle or a human operator at the driver's seat, for instance), then he/it may dispute control of the machine every second with a Quick Contest of the caster's effective skill vs. the operator's skill (or Will+TL for cybernetic control). A mage who knows this spell may use the Rider or Rider Within spells on machines; note, however, that a machine's sensory apparatus may not be readily intelligible to a human being!

name: Machine Summoning/TL
description: Call one machine of a named type (anything under IQ 6). Range does not matter for this spell. If the spell is successfully cast, the caster knows the location of the closest machine of the type and how long it will take for that machine to come to him. It moves towards the caster as fast as it can, until the spell ends or the machine reaches the immediate vicinity of the caster. Of course, the machine may not be very good at finding its way, or it may run out of fuel or power, etc. Once the machine reaches the caster, it stays nearby, without attacking, until the spell ends. The spell is broken if the caster or one of his companions attacks the machine.

name: Machine Speech/TL
description: Communicate with any machine (of any IQ) in the machine's own 'language.' Unless the language is sound-borne, the subject has to maintain physical contact with the machine's interface port or antenna. The amount of information exchanged depends on the machine's intelligence; no machine below IQ 3 will be likely to know much of interest. Each minute of the spell allows one question and answer.

name: Glitch/TL
description: The machine equivalent of Spasm. This spell causes something to go wrong for a moment with the subject machine. It may drop whatever it was holding, eject a part, miss a cog in its drive train, or garble a data packet. Ingenious casters will find all sorts of uses. The game effects can be anything from a trivial annoyance (if cast on a flashlight, for instance), to potentially deadly (if cast on an automedic in the middle of laser surgery).

name: Malfunction/TL
description: The mechanical equivalent of Total Paralysis. The subject machine simply ceases to function for the duration of the spell (an airplane falls, a sensor is 'blind,' and so on). The caster must touch the subject.

name: Schematic/TL
description: Creates detailed technical 'blueprints' of the machine subject in the caster's mind. The caster can browse through the mental schematic at his leisure or the same rate that he could examine actual hardcopy plans for the machine. However, this spell grants no appropriate skills; to interpret, for instance, a schematic of a starship's fusion power plant, the caster would need some skill in Engineering (Fusion). The duration is the length of time that the image stays with any useful clarity in the caster's mind. The caster must touch the subject during the casting.

name: Rebuild/TL
timeToCast: 1 sec. per point of energy required
prerequisites: Magery 3, Repair, Create Object, at least three spells of each element, and Schematic (for machines)
description: This spell is an improved version of Repair. It totally rebuilds any object, from even a fragment. The caster must first successfully cast Schematic on the subject, and, while the schematic is still in mind, begin casting Rebuild. Schematic is unnecessary for simpler objects. With enough power, you could rebuild a starship from a scrap of bulkhead!

name: Animate Machine/TL
initialCost: 8 for 1 ton, doubling per extra energy point
prerequisites: Machine Control and either Animation or Animate Object
description: Summons a spirit to animate a machine the mage is touching. Characters with the Machine meta-trait can be affected, though intelligent machines do get a chance to resist. The summoned spirit controls the animated machine just as if it were being operated in normal fashion, including all built-in accessories/weapons. The spirit has DX 10, IQ 9, and Automaton and Spirit meta-traits. It obeys the caster literally. On a critical failure during casting, a demon enters the machine and attempts to kill its summoner and anyone else it can reach.

name: Machine Possession/TL
prerequisites: Machine Control and either Rider Within or Soul Rider
description: Like Animate Machine, except that it is the caster's own spirit which animates the machine. The machine must have IQ 5 or less. The caster animates the subject just as if he was at its controls. He has full access to the machine's memories and abilities; he may use all its skills and abilities as though they were his own. He may use his own mental abilities, but not physical ones. The caster's body lies unconscious during the spell.

name: Permanent Machine Possession/TL
description: Like Machine Possession – but the caster remains in the subject machine until he chooses to leave or is exorcised by an appropriate spell (Dispel Possession, Remove Curse, Counterspell, etc). The caster's body remains in suspended animation while the spell lasts. If the caster's body dies, the spell is broken. Whenever the subject machine takes damage, the caster must roll on his own body's HT or take the same damage. Daily Will rolls are required to prevent IQ loss until machine IQ is reached.

name: Awaken Computer/TL
description: Awakens a computer's spirit, granting it awareness and sapience. If the computer is already inhabited by a sapient program, that program may resist; if it fails, it is rendered unconscious. The spirit has IQ equal to the computer's Complexity + 5, with full access to databases and peripherals. It obeys the caster faithfully but has free will. Computer spirits remember what happens each time they are awakened.

name: Seek Power/TL
description: Identifies the direction and approximate distance of the nearest significant source of power. Use long-distance modifiers. Unconnected/inactive power sources double the long-distance penalty.

name: Seek Fuel/TL
description: Identifies the direction and approximate distance of the nearest significant source of fuel. Use long-distance modifiers. Any particular types or known sources of fuel may be excluded if mentioned before beginning.

name: Purify Fuel/TL
description: Removes foreign objects and impurities from a fuel, rendering it fit to use. If the fuel has been completely corrupted by impurities, the spell removes them, leaving nothing.

name: Create Fuel/TL
description: Turns any natural substance into the primary solid or liquid fuel for the spell's TL. At TL5, turns rocks into coal; at TL7, turns rocks into uranium.

name: Essential Fuel/TL
description: Creates magical, highly refined fuel that produces three times the power per pound of normal fuel when burned or consumed. Cannot be tapped by Steal Power or Draw Power.

name: Stop Power
description: Stops the flow of power in the area, causing all powered devices to cease to function. This may or may not cause permanent damage to the devices, depending on their design. Any affected device works normally when it leaves the area.

name: Lend Power/TL
description: The caster expends energy to magically power a device. In theory, a large enough circle of mages could use this spell to power a starship and its weapons. Cannot be used to directly charge batteries or storage devices.

name: Propel/TL
description: Uses magical energy to operate any device that converts power or fuel into motion, from a lawn mower to a stardrive (usually vehicles). High skill does not reduce casting cost.

name: Conduct Power/TL
description: Turns the caster into a power conduit, a link between an active power source and a device in need of it. Range penalty is based on total distance from source to caster plus caster to sink. Non-visible sources/sinks apply penalties (-5 for one, -10 for both). Maintenance cost cannot be reduced by high skill.

name: Steal Power/TL
prerequisites: Magery 2, Minor Healing, and Conduct Power
description: The caster steals power from a stored power source (such as a battery) to restore his FP. The caster regains energy at a percentage efficiency equal to his skill level with the spell (e.g. skill 15 recovers 15% of the power potential).

name: Draw Power/TL
prerequisites: Steal Power and at least two spells from 10 different colleges
description: Identical to Conduct Power, except that the subject is a spell; a wizard can draw energy directly from a technological power plant (e.g., 10 MW fusion plant) to supply a steady stream of spell energy per second to power his magic! Draw Power must be cast first and counts as a spell on.

name: Magnetic Vision
description: Reveals magnetic fields to the subject. They are brightest where densest and seem to flow from one magnetic pole to the other. With Physics/TL6+ at 12+, can estimate field strength. Combined with 1,000x Microscopic Vision, can directly read magnetic data storage media.

name: Radio Hearing
description: The subject can 'tune' his hearing to the radio and microwave portions of the electromagnetic spectrum, as if he had Telecommunication (Radio) (Receive Only, -50%).

name: Spectrum Vision
description: The subject can perceive any portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, as if he had Hyperspectral Vision with Extended Low-Band and Extended High-Band enhancements. Scientific skill rolls may be required to interpret complex phenomena.

name: See Radiation
description: Makes all radioactive items visible in the subject's field of vision. Each such item glows in proportion to its activity. Items hidden under clothes or behind walls give off a glow depending on shielding penetration. Spells like Radiation Jet also become visible.

name: Seek Radiation
description: Identifies the direction and approximate distance of the nearest significant source of radiation of any sort. The caster can specify a particular type of radiation (gamma, neutron, etc.). Use long-distance modifiers.

name: Irradiate
prerequisites: At least two Earth spells and two Fire spells
description: Makes an area radioactive, inflicting a steady dose of rads per hour on anyone inside the area.

name: Extinguish Radiation
prerequisites: Magery 2, Extinguish Fire, Earth to Air, and Irradiate
description: Removes harmful radioactivity from the subject object or area permanently.

name: Resist Radiation
initialCost: 1 for PF 10, 2 for PF 100, 3 for PF 1,000
description: The subject (person, creature or object) and anything carried becomes resistant to radiation, expressed in terms of Protection Factor (PF 10, PF 100, or PF 1,000).

name: Cure Radiation
description: Heals the subject of radiation damage; reduces the inherent radiation dose in the subject's body, including the 10% 'permanent' retained dose. Does not restore lost HP or other physical injury directly.

name: Radiation Jet
description: Shoot an invisible beam of radiation from one finger. Roll vs. DX-4 or Innate Attack skill to hit. May be dodged or blocked (only by radiation-impervious shields), but not parried. Inflicts 10 rads per point of energy. Can fog film, scramble electronics, etc.

name: Breathe Radiation
description: Similar to Radiation Jet, except that the radiation issues from the caster's mouth and cannot be maintained. Roll vs. DX-4 or Innate Attack skill to hit. Can be cast 'no hands' with lip and tongue motions.

name: Identify Metal
description: Identifies the metal composition of an object touched by the caster.

name: Seek Plastic
description: Identifies the direction and approximate distance of the nearest plastic material. Use long-distance modifiers.

name: Identify Plastic
description: Identifies a plastic's type. The caster must touch the plastic to be identified.

name: Shape Metal
prerequisites: Magery 1 and either Shape Earth or at least six Tech spells
description: Move solid and liquid metal about and shape it into any form. If stable, it remains permanently after shaping. Solid metal moves at Move 1/2; liquid metal flows at Move 1/2 uphill, Move 4 horizontally, or Move 10 downhill.

name: Shape Plastic
prerequisites: Magery 1 and either Shape Plant or at least six Tech spells
description: Similar to Shape Metal, but affects plastic materials. Material moved travels at Move 1/2 or faster if ductile or liquid.

name: Metal Vision
description: See through metal to gaze upon whatever lies beyond – past the door, inside the chest, etc. Certain dense metals (lead) block this spell.

name: Plastic Vision
description: See through plastic to gaze upon whatever lies beyond.

name: Body of Metal
description: Subject becomes an animated metal statue, gaining the Body of Metal meta-trait (DR 9, ST+10, Unnatural Attributes, Pressure/Vacuum Support, etc.). Clothes become metal up to 6 lbs. Speech and spellcasting remain possible.

name: Body of Plastic
description: Subject becomes an animated plastic statue, gaining the Body of Plastic meta-trait (DR 4, Insulation, High Flexibility, etc.). Speech and spellcasting remain possible.

name: Seek Water
description: Tells the caster the direction and distance to the nearest significant body of water (at least 1 gallon). The caster may specify a particular type of water (e.g., fresh water, salt water, pure water) when casting.

name: Purify Water
description: Removes all pollution, poison, salt, silt, and impurities from water, making it clean and drinkable. Does not affect non-water liquids.

name: Create Water
description: Creates pure, drinkable water out of nothing. Water appears in a container if one is present, or falls to the ground/floors as a splash.

name: Destroy Water
description: Instantly vanishes water from existence. Can be used to dry clothes, empty flooded spaces, or destroy liquid water. Cannot be cast on water inside a living creature unless Dehydrate is used.

name: Shape Water
description: Allows the caster to move water around, form water sculptures, part water to walk through, or hold water in mid-air without a container. Move is 3.

name: Fog
description: Creates a thick cloud of fog in the area of effect. Reduces vision through the fog by -2 per yard of thickness. Full darkness at 10 yards.

name: Umbrella
description: Keeps the subject completely dry regardless of rain, splashes, or damp environment. Does not allow underwater breathing or protection against high-pressure submersion.

name: Water Vision
description: Allows the subject to see clearly through murky, muddy, or silted water as if it were crystal clear. Eliminates visual penalties caused by cloudiness in water.

name: Breathe Water
description: Allows a air-breathing creature to breathe liquid water normally without drowning. Subject can still breathe air while spell is active.

name: Breathe Air
description: Allows an aquatic creature (gills) to breathe air comfortably while on land without suffocating.

name: Water Jet
description: Shoots a high-pressure stream of water from the caster's hand. Requires an Innate Attack roll to hit. Range is 10 yards. Deals 1d knockback/crushing damage per energy point spent (max 3d). Can extinguish fires and knock targets down.

name: Frostbite
description: Deals 1d-1 toxic/freezing damage per energy point invested (up to 3 points). Ignores non-thermal armor DR unless specialized against cold.

name: Icy Weapon
description: Coats a weapon in magical sub-zero ice. Adds +2 freezing/chilling damage to all successful weapon strikes. Affected targets must roll HT or suffer -1 DX from numbness.

name: Ice Slick
description: Coats the ground in the target area with ultra-slippery ice. Anyone walking across or standing in the area must make DX or DX-based skill checks to avoid falling prone.

name: Hail
description: Causes heavy hail to fall from above over the area. Deals 1d-3 crushing damage per second to all exposed targets without overhead cover. Also reduces movement and visibility.

name: Snow
description: Causes gentle to heavy snowfall over the target area, creating snow accumulation and dropping ambient temperature.

name: Ice Dagger
description: Forms a razor-sharp dagger of solid ice in hand and launches it at target. Deals 1d+1 impaling damage per energy point (up to 3d+3). Acc 2, Range 20/40.

name: Freeze
description: Instantly freezes liquid water into solid ice. Can be used to freeze standing water, ponds, or created water.

name: Melt Ice
description: Instantly melts solid ice or snow back into liquid water.

name: Snow Shoes
description: Allows the subject to walk across soft snow, slush, or slick ice without sinking, slipping, or suffering movement penalties.

name: Walk on Water
description: Allows the subject to walk, run, or stand on liquid water as if it were solid ground. High waves may require DX tests to maintain balance.

name: Water Wall
description: Creates a thick wall of rushing water. Missiles passing through suffer -4 to hit and reduced damage; fire attacks are extinguished when passing through.

name: Ice Wall
description: Creates a solid wall of ice. The wall has DR 4 and 20 HP per yard of thickness. Melts under high heat or fire attacks.

name: Whirlpool
description: Creates a violent swirling vortex in open water. Swimmers and boats in the area are sucked toward the center and down unless they win a Swimming/Boating contest against spell skill.

name: Current
description: Creates or alters a water current in rivers, lakes, or oceans. Speeds up or slows down boat travel by up to 5 mph in the chosen direction.

name: Waves
description: Generates water waves of specified height (up to 10 feet). Can capsize small boats or knock down swimmers.

name: Rain
description: Causes moderate rain to fall from clouds over the area of effect, extinguishing open fires and dampening terrain.

name: Dehydrate
description: Magically pulls moisture directly out of a living subject's body. Deals 1d FP or HP damage per energy point spent (subject resists with HT). Reduces Fatigue and causes intense thirst.

name: Essential Water
description: Creates magical Essential Water. One cup satisfies thirst for a full day. Extinguishes normal fires 3x faster than normal water and cannot be contaminated by ordinary non-magical means.

name: Body of Water
description: Transforms the caster and gear into living fluid water. Provides Injury Tolerance (Diffuse), immunity to crushing/impaling physical attacks, ability to flow through cracks, but vulnerability to fire/heat.

name: Body of Ice
description: Transforms caster into living ice. Grants +3 DR, immunity to cold damage, +2 ST, but double damage from fire/heat attacks.

name: Summon Elemental (Water)
description: Summons a Water Elemental from its home plane. Elemental requires a reaction/command test to obey.

name: Control Elemental (Water)
description: Gains control over a Water Elemental. Resisted by Elemental's Will.

name: Create Elemental (Water)
description: Creates a loyal Water Elemental out of a body of natural water.
